# **CHUNK-BASED AR.JS SYSTEEM - TECHNISCHE DOCUMENTATIE**

## **Probleem Context**

Je had een AR website met meerdere posters die elk hun eigen `.mind` bestand hadden voor AR herkenning. Het probleem was:

1. **Performance**: Elk `.mind` bestand is 1-2 MB groot
2. **Switching Speed**: Individuele bestanden laden bij elke poster switch was traag
3. **Memory**: Veel separate fetch requests en WebGL contexts

## **De Oplossing: Chunk-Based System**

Het systeem werkte in twee delen:

### **DEEL 1: BACKEND - Merge Script (merge_mind_files.js)**

**Locatie**: merge_mind_files.js

**Wat het deed**:
```javascript
// STAP 1: Alle individuele .mind bestanden verzamelen
const ASSETS_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../assets/nft');
// Bijvoorbeeld:
// - assets/nft/AR_test_01/AR_test_01.mind
// - assets/nft/poster_2/poster_2.mind
// - assets/nft/poster_3/poster_3.mind

// STAP 2: Sorteer op upload tijd (nieuwste eerst)
mindFiles.sort((a, b) => {
    const statA = fs.statSync(a.path);
    const statB = fs.statSync(b.path);
    return statB.mtime.getTime() - statA.mtime.getTime();
});

// STAP 3: Verdeel in chunks van 10 posters
const CHUNK_SIZE = 10;
for (let i = 0; i < mindFiles.length; i += CHUNK_SIZE) {
    const chunkFiles = mindFiles.slice(i, i + CHUNK_SIZE);
    // Chunk 0: Poster 0-9 (nieuwste)
    // Chunk 1: Poster 10-19
    // Chunk 2: Poster 20-29
    // etc.
}

// STAP 4: MsgPack structuur per .mind bestand
// Elk .mind bestand is een MsgPack encoded object:
{
    v: 2,  // MindAR versie
    dataList: [
        { /* AR tracking data voor target 0 */ },
        { /* AR tracking data voor target 1 */ },
        // ... meer targets
    ]
}

// STAP 5: Merge de dataList arrays samen
const chunkDataList = [];
for (const file of chunkFiles) {
    const buffer = fs.readFileSync(file.path);
    const content = decode(buffer);  // MsgPack decode
    
    // Voeg alle targets toe aan chunk
    content.dataList.forEach((data) => {
        chunkDataList.push(data);
    });
}

// STAP 6: Creëer gemerged chunk file
const mergedContent = {
    v: 2,
    dataList: chunkDataList  // Nu bevat targets van 10 posters
};
const encoded = encode(mergedContent);  // MsgPack encode
fs.writeFileSync('assets/chunks/chunk_0.mind', encoded);
```

**Output structuur**:
```
assets/chunks/
├── chunk_0.mind    (1.4 MB - bevat 10 posters)
├── chunk_1.mind    (1.4 MB - bevat 10 posters)
├── chunk_2.mind    (1.4 MB - bevat 10 posters)
└── manifest.json   (metadata)
```

**Manifest structuur**:
```json
{
  "generatedAt": "2025-12-04T10:36:02.435Z",
  "totalPosters": 25,
  "chunkSize": 10,
  "chunks": [
    {
      "file": "chunk_0.mind",
      "posterIds": ["poster_25", "poster_24", "poster_23", ...]
    },
    {
      "file": "chunk_1.mind", 
      "posterIds": ["poster_15", "poster_14", "poster_13", ...]
    }
  ]
}
```

### **DEEL 2: FRONTEND - Chunk Loading System**

**Hoe het werkte in de frontend (app.js)**:

```javascript
// === STAP 1: MANIFEST LADEN ===
async function initAR() {
    // Laad manifest om te weten welke chunks er zijn
    const manifestResponse = await fetch('assets/chunks/manifest.json');
    const manifest = await manifestResponse.json();
    
    console.log(`📦 ${manifest.chunks.length} chunks beschikbaar`);
    
    // === STAP 2: LAAD CHUNK 0 (NIEUWSTE POSTERS) ===
    // Chunk 0 bevat de meest recent geüploade posters
    const firstChunkUrl = `assets/chunks/${manifest.chunks[0].file}`;
    
    // === STAP 3: GEBRUIK CHUNK IN MINDAR ===
    // MindAR accepteert een URL naar een .mind bestand
    const scene = `
        <a-scene
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${firstChunkUrl}; maxTrack: 1;">
            
            <!-- Target index 0 = eerste poster in chunk -->
            <a-entity mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0">
                <a-plane src="poster_25_layer_1.png"></a-plane>
            </a-entity>
            
            <!-- Target index 1 = tweede poster in chunk -->
            <a-entity mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 1">
                <a-plane src="poster_24_layer_1.png"></a-plane>
            </a-entity>
            
            <!-- etc. tot targetIndex: 9 -->
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // === STAP 4: TARGET INDEX MAPPING ===
    // Belangrijk: Je moet bijhouden welke targetIndex bij welke poster hoort
    const posterToTargetIndex = new Map();
    manifest.chunks[0].posterIds.forEach((posterId, index) => {
        posterToTargetIndex.set(posterId, index);
        console.log(`Poster ${posterId} -> targetIndex ${index} in chunk_0`);
    });
    
    // Als je poster "poster_23" wilt tonen:
    const targetIndex = posterToTargetIndex.get("poster_23"); // -> 2
    // Gebruik dan mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 2"
}

// === STAP 5: PROGRESSIVE LOADING (optioneel) ===
// Laad eerst chunk 0, dan lazy load andere chunks
async function loadAllChunks(manifest) {
    // Chunk 0 is al geladen voor snelle start
    
    // Laad rest in background
    for (let i = 1; i < manifest.chunks.length; i++) {
        const chunkUrl = `assets/chunks/${manifest.chunks[i].file}`;
        
        // Preload als Blob voor snelle switch
        const response = await fetch(chunkUrl);
        const blob = await response.blob();
        const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        
        chunkBlobUrls.set(i, blobUrl);
        console.log(`✅ Chunk ${i} preloaded`);
    }
}

// === STAP 6: CHUNK SWITCHING ===
// Als gebruiker naar oudere posters scrollt, switch naar andere chunk
async function switchToChunk(chunkIndex) {
    const blobUrl = chunkBlobUrls.get(chunkIndex);
    
    // Verwijder oude scene
    const oldScene = document.querySelector('a-scene');
    oldScene.remove();
    
    // Creëer nieuwe scene met andere chunk
    const newScene = `
        <a-scene
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${blobUrl}; maxTrack: 1;">
            <!-- Targets voor deze chunk -->
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', newScene);
}
```

## **KEY ADVANTAGES van dit systeem**

### **1. Snellere Initialisatie**
```javascript
// OUD: Laad 25 individuele .mind bestanden
for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
    await fetch(`poster_${i}.mind`); // 25 requests, 25-50 MB
}

// NIEUW: Laad 1 chunk bestand
await fetch('chunk_0.mind'); // 1 request, 1.4 MB
```

### **2. Progressive Loading**
```javascript
// Chunk 0 (nieuwste 10) direct laden
// Chunk 1, 2, 3 in background laden terwijl gebruiker AR gebruikt
```

### **3. Memory Efficiency**
```javascript
// Slechts 1 MindAR controller nodig per chunk
// Max 10 targets tegelijk in memory (niet alle 25+)
```

### **4. Smart Caching met Blob URLs**
```javascript
// Elk chunk bestand 1x fetchen, dan blob URL voor instant re-use
const blob = await response.blob();
const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
// blobUrl blijft in browser memory, geen re-download nodig
```

## **WAAROM HET NU NIET MEER WERKT**

Kijkend naar je huidige app.js:

```javascript
// HUIDIGE CODE (regel 215-232):
// PRELOAD all .mind files into memory for instant switching
console.log('📦 Preloading all .mind files...');
for (const poster of validPosters) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(poster.mindPath);  // ❌ Individuele files
        // ...
        preloadedMindData.set(poster.id, {
            poster: poster,
            data: arrayBuffer,
            mindPath: poster.mindPath
        });
    }
}
```

**Het probleem**: Het systeem preload nog steeds **individuele** `.mind` bestanden (`poster.mindPath`), niet de **chunks** (chunk_0.mind).

## **WAT ER MOET GEBEUREN OM HET TE FIXEN**

1. **Laad manifest.json** in plaats van individuele poster paths
2. **Map poster IDs** naar chunk index + target index
3. **Switch tussen chunks** in plaats van individuele .mind bestanden
4. **Update mindar-image-target** met correcte targetIndex

```javascript
// PSEUDO-CODE voor fix:
async function initChunkBasedAR() {
    // 1. Laad manifest
    const manifest = await fetch('assets/chunks/manifest.json').then(r => r.json());
    
    // 2. Bouw mapping: posterId -> {chunkIndex, targetIndex}
    const posterMapping = new Map();
    manifest.chunks.forEach((chunk, chunkIdx) => {
        chunk.posterIds.forEach((posterId, targetIdx) => {
            posterMapping.set(posterId, {
                chunkIndex: chunkIdx,
                targetIndex: targetIdx,
                chunkFile: chunk.file
            });
        });
    });
    
    // 3. Preload chunks (niet individuele .mind files)
    for (const chunk of manifest.chunks) {
        const response = await fetch(`assets/chunks/${chunk.file}`);
        const blob = await response.blob();
        const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        chunkBlobUrls.set(chunk.file, blobUrl);
    }
    
    // 4. Bij AR activatie: gebruik chunk file + targetIndex
    function activateARForPoster(posterId) {
        const mapping = posterMapping.get(posterId);
        const chunkUrl = chunkBlobUrls.get(mapping.chunkFile);
        
        // Update scene met chunk URL en target index
        scene.setAttribute('mindar-image', `imageTargetSrc: ${chunkUrl}`);
        target.setAttribute('mindar-image-target', `targetIndex: ${mapping.targetIndex}`);
    }
}
```

---

**SAMENVATTING**: Het chunk systeem merge meerdere `.mind` bestanden in grotere "chunk" bestanden, laadt deze chunks in plaats van individuele files, en gebruikt `targetIndex` om te weten welke poster in welke chunk zit. Je huidige code laadt nog steeds individuele `.mind` bestanden, vandaar dat het chunk systeem niet werkt.

// 3. Preload chunks (NIET individuele files)

            // Build mapping: posterId → {chunkIndex, targetIndex, chunkFile}
            manifestData.chunks.forEach((chunk, chunkIdx) => {
                chunk.posterIds.forEach((posterId, targetIdx) => {
                    posterMapping.set(posterId, {
                        chunkIndex: chunkIdx,
                        targetIndex: targetIdx,
                        chunkFile: chunk.file
                    });
                    console.log(`  📍 ${posterId} → chunk ${chunkIdx}, target ${targetIdx}`);
                });
            });
            
            // Preload all chunks as blob URLs for instant loading
            console.log('📦 Preloading chunks...');
            for (const chunk of manifestData.chunks) {
                try {
                    const chunkUrl = `assets/chunks/${chunk.file}`;
                    const response = await fetch(chunkUrl);
                    if (response.ok) {
                        const blob = await response.blob();
                        const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                        chunkBlobUrls.set(chunk.file, blobUrl);
                        console.log(`✅ Chunk ${chunk.file} preloaded (${(blob.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB) → blob URL`);
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    console.warn(`⚠️ Failed to preload chunk ${chunk.file}:`, e);
                }
            }
            console.log(`📦 Preloaded ${chunkBlobUrls.size}/${manifestData.chunks.length} chunks`);
            
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('❌ Failed to load chunk system, falling back to legacy system:', e);
            // Fallback: use old individual .mind file system
            manifestData = null;
        }

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - CHUNK-BASED SYSTEM
// HIDDEN SCANNER: Scene runs behind static camera feed until poster detected
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene (chunk-based mode)...');
    
    if (!window.arPosters || window.arPosters.length === 0) {
        console.error('❌ No posters available!');
        return;
    }
    
    // === CHUNK-BASED SYSTEM ===
    let mindSrc, targetIndex;
    
    if (manifestData && chunkBlobUrls.size > 0) {
        // Use chunk system
        const firstChunk = manifestData.chunks[0];
        const chunkBlobUrl = chunkBlobUrls.get(firstChunk.file);
        
        if (chunkBlobUrl) {
            mindSrc = chunkBlobUrl;
            targetIndex = 0; // Start with first target in chunk
            console.log(`🎯 Using chunk ${firstChunk.file} with ${firstChunk.posterIds.length} targets`);
            console.log(`📍 Target 0 = ${firstChunk.posterIds[0]}`);
        } else {
            console.warn('⚠️ Chunk blob URL not found, falling back to legacy');
            const currentPoster = window.arPosters[0];
            mindSrc = currentPoster.mindPath;
            targetIndex = 0;
        }
    } else {
        // Fallback to legacy individual .mind file
        console.log('⚠️ Chunk system not available, using legacy individual .mind files');
        const currentPoster = window.arPosters[0];
        mindSrc = currentPoster.mindPath;
        targetIndex = 0;
    }
    
    // Get the first poster for layers (will be updated on detection)
    const currentPoster = window.arPosters[0];
    console.log('🎯 Initial poster:', currentPoster.title);
    
    // Build layers HTML using helper function
    const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(currentPoster);

```
function buildLayersHTML(poster) {
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add black background layer - BEHIND all other layers (negative Z)
    // Make it larger than the poster to cover any gaps
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 -0.01" 
            height="2" 
            width="1.5" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double; shader: flat;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                
                // Use a-image for automatic aspect ratio handling
                // a-image automatically maintains correct aspect ratio of the image
                // Width=1 means full width of the detected target in MindAR
                layersHTML += `
                    <a-image 
                        id="ar-layer-${i}"
                        src="${imagePath}" 
                        position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                        width="1" 
                        height="1"
                        rotation="0 0 0"
                        transparent="true"
                        alpha-test="0.5"
                        ${exclusionAttr}></a-image>`;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    return layersHTML;
}
```

- oldString:

```
function buildLayersHTML(poster) {
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add black background layer - BEHIND all other layers (negative Z)
    // Make it larger than the poster to cover any gaps
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 -0.01" 
            height="2" 
            width="1.5" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double; shader: flat;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                
                // Use data attributes to store image path for aspect ratio calculation
                layersHTML += `
                    <a-plane 
                        id="ar-layer-${i}"
                        src="${imagePath}" 
                        position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                        height="1.4" 
                        width="1.4" 
                        rotation="0 0 0"
                        data-image-src="${imagePath}"
                        data-preserve-aspect="true"
                        ${materialAttr}
                        ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    return layersHTML;
}
```

- oldString:

```
// Fix aspect ratios for each layer based on image dimensions
function fixLayerAspectRatios() {
    // For each layer that has data-preserve-aspect
    const layers = document.querySelectorAll('[data-preserve-aspect="true"]');
    
    layers.forEach(layer => {
        const imageSrc = layer.getAttribute('data-image-src');
        if (!imageSrc) return;
        
        // Create image to get dimensions
        const img = new Image();
        img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
        
        img.onload = function() {
            try {
                const imageRatio = img.width / img.height;
                const maxHeight = 1.4;
                
                let newWidth = maxHeight * imageRatio;
                let newHeight = maxHeight;
                
                // Cap maximum width
                if (newWidth > 2.0) {
                    newWidth = 2.0;
                    newHeight = 2.0 / imageRatio;
                }
                
                // Apply new dimensions
                layer.setAttribute('width', newWidth.toFixed(3));
                layer.setAttribute('height', newHeight.toFixed(3));
                
                console.log(`📐 Fixed ${layer.id}: ${newWidth.toFixed(2)}x${newHeight.toFixed(2)}`);
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn(`⚠️ Error fixing ${layer.id}:`, e);
            }
        };
        
        img.onerror = function() {
            console.warn(`⚠️ Could not load image for aspect ratio: ${imageSrc}`);
        };
        
        img.src = imageSrc;
    });
}
```

// Initialize AR Scene (MindAR) - CHUNK-BASED SYSTEM WITH DYNAMIC LAYERS
// HIDDEN SCANNER: Scene runs behind static camera feed until poster detected
function initializeARScene() {
    console.log('🎬 Initializing MindAR scene (chunk-based mode)...');
    
    if (!window.arPosters || window.arPosters.length === 0) {
        console.error('❌ No posters available!');
        return;
    }
    
    // === CHUNK-BASED SYSTEM ===
    let mindSrc, targetIndex;
    
    if (manifestData && chunkBlobUrls.size > 0) {
        // Use chunk system
        const firstChunk = manifestData.chunks[0];
        const chunkBlobUrl = chunkBlobUrls.get(firstChunk.file);
        
        if (chunkBlobUrl) {
            mindSrc = chunkBlobUrl;
            targetIndex = 0; // Start with first target in chunk
            console.log(`🎯 Using chunk ${firstChunk.file} with ${firstChunk.posterIds.length} targets`);
            console.log(`📍 Target 0 = ${firstChunk.posterIds[0]}`);
        } else {
            console.warn('⚠️ Chunk blob URL not found, falling back to legacy');
            const currentPoster = window.arPosters[0];
            mindSrc = currentPoster.mindPath;
            targetIndex = 0;
        }
    } else {
        // Fallback to legacy individual .mind file
        console.log('⚠️ Chunk system not available, using legacy individual .mind files');
        const currentPoster = window.arPosters[0];
        mindSrc = currentPoster.mindPath;
        targetIndex = 0;
    }
    
    // Get the first poster for layers (will be updated on detection)
    const currentPoster = window.arPosters[0];
    console.log('🎯 Initial poster:', currentPoster.title);
    
    // Create scene HTML WITHOUT layers (will add them dynamically)
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${mindSrc}; filterMinCF: 0.0001; filterBeta: 0.001; warmupTolerance: 0; missTolerance: 2;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${currentPoster.id}" data-target-index="0">
                <!-- Layers will be added dynamically below -->
            </a-entity>
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    // Add scene to body
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    console.log('✅ Hidden AR scene added for poster:', currentPoster.title);
    
    // Get reference to scene and target
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
    
    // NOW add layers dynamically to target AFTER scene is in DOM
    addLayersToTarget(target, currentPoster);
    
    // Setup event listeners using helper function
    setupSceneEventListeners(scene, currentPoster);
    
    // Additional setup for first load
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ Hidden AR scanner ready');
        
        // Process exclusion filter layers
        setTimeout(() => {
            processExclusionFilters();
        }, 1000);
        
        // Hide loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) loader.classList.add('hidden');
        
        // Apply grayscale filter to AR scene videos
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 200);
    });
    
    // Setup swipe bar controls
    setupSwipeBarControls();
    
    // Setup gallery overlay
    setupGalleryOverlay();
    
    // Force gallery overlay styles
    injectGalleryStyles();
    
    console.log('✅ AR scene initialized (hidden behind static feed)');
}

// Add layers dynamically to a target entity using a-image
function addLayersToTarget(target, poster) {
    console.log('🎨 Adding layers to target:', poster.title);
    
    // First add black background layer
    const bgLayer = document.createElement('a-plane');
    bgLayer.setAttribute('id', 'ar-layer-0');
    bgLayer.setAttribute('position', '0 0 -0.01');
    bgLayer.setAttribute('height', '2');
    bgLayer.setAttribute('width', '1.5');
    bgLayer.setAttribute('rotation', '0 0 0');
    bgLayer.setAttribute('material', 'color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double; shader: flat;');
    target.appendChild(bgLayer);
    
    // Add image layers dynamically
    let layerCount = 0;
    
    if (poster && poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerKey = `layer_${i}`;
            const layerData = poster.layers[layerKey];
            
            // Skip if no layer data or no filename
            if (!layerData || !layerData.filename) {
                continue;
            }
            
            layerCount++;
            const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
            const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
            
            // Create a-image element (automatically handles aspect ratio!)
            const layer = document.createElement('a-image');
            layer.setAttribute('id', `ar-layer-${i}`);
            layer.setAttribute('position', `0 0 ${zPos}`);
            layer.setAttribute('rotation', '0 0 0');
            layer.setAttribute('width', '1');     // Full width of target
            layer.setAttribute('height', '1');    // Auto-adjusted by a-image
            layer.setAttribute('src', imagePath);
            layer.setAttribute('transparent', 'true');
            layer.setAttribute('alpha-test', '0.5');
            layer.setAttribute('visible', 'true');
            
            if (layerData.exclusion_filter) {
                layer.setAttribute('data-exclusion', 'true');
            }
            
            // Add animations if configured
            const animX = parseFloat(layerData.anim_x) || 0;
            const animY = parseFloat(layerData.anim_y) || 0;
            const animZ = parseFloat(layerData.anim_z) || 0;
            const animDuration = parseInt(layerData.anim_duration) || 2000;
            
            if (animX > 0 || animY > 0 || animZ > 0) {
                if (animX > 0) {
                    layer.setAttribute('animation__x', `property: position.x; from: ${-animX}; to: ${animX}; dur: ${animDuration}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                }
                if (animY > 0) {
                    layer.setAttribute('animation__y', `property: position.y; from: ${-animY}; to: ${animY}; dur: ${animDuration * 1.1}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                }
                if (animZ > 0) {
                    layer.setAttribute('animation__z', `property: position.z; from: ${zPos - animZ}; to: ${zPos + animZ}; dur: ${animDuration * 1.2}; dir: alternate; loop: true; easing: easeInOutQuad`);
                }
            }
            
            target.appendChild(layer);
            console.log(`✅ Layer ${i} added: ${imagePath}`);
        }
    }
    
    console.log(`✅ Added ${layerCount} image layers to target`);
}
```

function buildLayersHTML(poster) {
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add black background layer - BEHIND all other layers (negative Z)
    // Make it larger than the poster to cover any gaps
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 -0.01" 
            height="2" 
            width="1.5" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double; shader: flat;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                const zPos = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const imagePath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                
                // Use a-image for automatic aspect ratio handling
                // a-image automatically maintains correct aspect ratio of the image
                // Width=1 means full width of the detected target in MindAR
                layersHTML += `
                    <a-image 
                        id="ar-layer-${i}"
                        src="${imagePath}" 
                        position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                        width="1" 
                        height="1"
                        rotation="0 0 0"
                        transparent="true"
                        alpha-test="0.5"
                        ${exclusionAttr}></a-image>`;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    return layersHTML;
}
```

// Pre-build all scene HTML at startup for instant switching
function prebuildAllSceneHTML() {
    if (!window.arPosters) return;
    
    console.log('🏗️ Pre-building scene HTML for all posters...');
    window.arPosters.forEach((poster, index) => {

                    ${layersHTML}

        `;
        
        prebuiltSceneHTML.set(poster.id, sceneHTML);

}

async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    // Prevent concurrent switches
    if (isSwitching) {
        return false;
    }
    
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    isSwitching = true;
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    // Update global state
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    // Use blob URL if available (faster), otherwise fall back to file path
    const blobUrl = mindBlobUrls.get(newPoster.id);
    window.arMarkerPath = blobUrl || newPoster.mindPath;
    
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!existingScene) {
        isSwitching = false;
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // FAST CLEANUP: Stop MindAR processing immediately
        const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems?.['mindar-image-system'];
        if (mindarSystem) {
            if (mindarSystem.controller) {
                mindarSystem.controller.processingVideo = false;
            }
            if (mindarSystem.video) {
                mindarSystem.video.pause();
            }
        }
        
        // Save WebGL context reference for cleanup
        const canvas = existingScene.querySelector('canvas');
        if (canvas) {
            lastWebGLContext = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('webgl2');
        }
        
        // Quick wait for cleanup
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 40));
        
        // Force WebGL cleanup before removing scene
        cleanupWebGLContexts();
        
        // Remove existing scene
        existingScene.remove();
        
        // Minimal DOM cleanup wait
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
        
        // Build scene WITHOUT layers (we'll add them dynamically)
        const mindSrc = mindBlobUrls.get(newPoster.id) || newPoster.mindPath;
        const sceneHTML = `
            <a-scene
                id="ar-scene"
                mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${mindSrc}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 0; missTolerance: 2;"
                color-space="sRGB"
                renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
                vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
                device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
                
                <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
                
                <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${newPoster.id}" data-target-index="0">
                    <!-- Layers added dynamically -->
                </a-entity>
            </a-scene>
        `;
        
        document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
        
        // Now add layers dynamically
        const target = document.getElementById('ar-target-0');
        addLayersToTarget(target, newPoster);
        
        // Setup event listeners
        const newScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
        setupSceneEventListeners(newScene, newPoster);
        
        // Apply video filter
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 100);
        
        isSwitching = false;
        return true;

async function quickSwitchPoster(posterIndex) {
    // Prevent concurrent switches
    if (isSwitching) {
        return false;
    }
    
    if (!window.arPosters || posterIndex < 0 || posterIndex >= window.arPosters.length) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Don't switch if paused (poster detected)
    if (scannerPaused) {
        return false;
    }
    
    isSwitching = true;
    
    const newPoster = window.arPosters[posterIndex];
    
    // Update scanning indicator
    updateScanningIndicator(newPoster, posterIndex, window.arPosters.length);
    
    // Update global state
    window.currentARPosterIndex = posterIndex;
    
    // Use blob URL if available (faster), otherwise fall back to file path
    const blobUrl = mindBlobUrls.get(newPoster.id);
    window.arMarkerPath = blobUrl || newPoster.mindPath;
    
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    
    if (!existingScene) {
        isSwitching = false;
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // FAST CLEANUP: Stop MindAR processing immediately
        const mindarSystem = existingScene.systems?.['mindar-image-system'];
        if (mindarSystem) {
            if (mindarSystem.controller) {
                mindarSystem.controller.processingVideo = false;
            }
            if (mindarSystem.video) {
                mindarSystem.video.pause();
            }
        }
        
        // Save WebGL context reference for cleanup
        const canvas = existingScene.querySelector('canvas');
        if (canvas) {
            lastWebGLContext = canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('webgl2');
        }
        
        // Quick wait for cleanup
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 40));
        
        // Force WebGL cleanup before removing scene
        cleanupWebGLContexts();
        
        // Remove existing scene
        existingScene.remove();
        
        // Minimal DOM cleanup wait
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
        
        // Use pre-built scene HTML if available (much faster!)
        const sceneHTML = prebuiltSceneHTML.get(newPoster.id);
        if (!sceneHTML) {
            console.warn(`⚠️ No prebuilt HTML for poster ${newPoster.id}, building on-the-fly`);
            // Fallback: build HTML on-the-fly
            const mindSrc = mindBlobUrls.get(newPoster.id) || newPoster.mindPath;
            const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(newPoster);
            const fallbackHTML = `
                <a-scene
                    id="ar-scene"
                    mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${mindSrc}; filterMinCF: 0.0005; filterBeta: 0.003; warmupTolerance: 0; missTolerance: 2;"
                    color-space="sRGB"
                    renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
                    vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
                    device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
                    
                    <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
                    
                    <a-entity id="ar-target-0" mindar-image-target="targetIndex: 0" data-poster-id="${newPoster.id}">
                        ${layersHTML}
                    </a-entity>
                </a-scene>
            `;
            document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', fallbackHTML);
        } else {
            // Use prebuilt HTML for instant loading!
            document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
        }
        
        // Setup event listeners
        const newScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
        setupSceneEventListeners(newScene, newPoster);
        
        // Apply video filter
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 100);
        
        isSwitching = false;
        return true;

# **CHUNK-BASED AR SYSTEEM - HOE HET OP 4 DECEMBER WERKTE**

## **Inleiding: Waarom het op 4 december beter werkte**

Op 4 december had je een **chunk-based AR systeem** dat goed werkte. Dit systeem:
- ✅ Gebruikte samengemerged `.mind` bestanden (chunks)
- ✅ Had een statische camera overlay (geen glitching)
- ✅ Schakelde tussen chunks zonder scene vernieuwen
- ✅ Had proper aspect ratio handling

**Nu** (10 december) laad je **individuele** `.mind` bestanden, wat leidt tot:
- ❌ Glitching lagen
- ❌ Foutieve aspect ratios
- ❌ Trager switching

---

## **SYSTEEM ARCHITECTUUR (December 4)**

### **A. MANIFEST SYSTEEM**

```javascript
// 1. manifest.json wordacht geladen
const manifestResponse = await fetch('assets/chunks/manifest.json');
const manifestData = await manifestResponse.json();

// Structuur:
{
    "generatedAt": "2025-12-04T10:36:02.435Z",
    "totalPosters": 25,
    "chunkSize": 10,
    "chunks": [
        {
            "file": "chunk_0.mind",      // Bevat posters 0-9
            "posterIds": ["poster_25", "poster_24", ..., "poster_16"]
        },
        {
            "file": "chunk_1.mind",      // Bevat posters 10-19
            "posterIds": ["poster_15", "poster_14", ..., "poster_6"]
        },
        {
            "file": "chunk_2.mind",      // Bevat posters 20+
            "posterIds": ["poster_5", "poster_4", ..., "poster_1"]
        }
    ]
}
```

### **B. POSTER MAPPING**

```javascript
// Build mapping: posterId → {chunkIndex, targetIndex, chunkFile}
const posterMapping = new Map();

manifestData.chunks.forEach((chunk, chunkIdx) => {
    chunk.posterIds.forEach((posterId, targetIdx) => {
        posterMapping.set(posterId, {
            chunkIndex: chunkIdx,
            targetIndex: targetIdx,  // Position in chunk (0-9)
            chunkFile: chunk.file     // chunk_0.mind, chunk_1.mind, etc.
        });
    });
});

// VOORBEELD:
// posterMapping.get("poster_25") → {chunkIndex: 0, targetIndex: 0, chunkFile: "chunk_0.mind"}
// posterMapping.get("poster_24") → {chunkIndex: 0, targetIndex: 1, chunkFile: "chunk_0.mind"}
// posterMapping.get("poster_23") → {chunkIndex: 0, targetIndex: 2, chunkFile: "chunk_0.mind"}
// posterMapping.get("poster_15") → {chunkIndex: 1, targetIndex: 0, chunkFile: "chunk_1.mind"}
```

### **C. CHUNK PRELOADING**

```javascript
// Preload alle chunks als blob URLs voor instant loading
const chunkBlobUrls = new Map();

for (const chunk of manifestData.chunks) {
    try {
        const chunkUrl = `assets/chunks/${chunk.file}`;
        const response = await fetch(chunkUrl);
        
        if (response.ok) {
            const blob = await response.blob();
            const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            chunkBlobUrls.set(chunk.file, blobUrl);
            
            console.log(`✅ Chunk ${chunk.file} preloaded 
                (${(blob.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB) → blob URL`);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`⚠️ Failed to preload chunk ${chunk.file}`);
    }
}

// VOORDEEL: In-memory blob URLs, niet telkens re-fetchen!
```

## **INITIALIZATION FLOW (Dec 4)**

```javascript
async function initializeChunkAR() {
    console.log('🚀 Initializing Chunk AR System');
    
    // 1. Start met eerste chunk
    window.currentChunkIndex = 0;
    const firstChunk = window.arManifest.chunks[0];
    
    // 2. Initialize statische camera feed (BELANGRIJK!)
    //    Dit creëert een overlay die de AR scene verbergt tot een poster gevonden is
    await initializeStaticCameraFeed();
    
    // 3. Load de scene voor eerste chunk
    loadChunkScene(0);
    
    // 4. Show Scan Button (laat gebruiker manually chunks scannen)
    setTimeout(() => showScanButton('Scan'), 2000);
}
```

### **Key Point: Static Camera Feed**

```javascript
async function initializeStaticCameraFeed() {
    // Request camera access
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { 
            facingMode: 'environment',
            width: { ideal: 1920 },
            height: { ideal: 1080 }
        }
    });
    
    staticCameraStream = stream;
    
    // Create static video element overlay
    const staticVideo = document.createElement('video');
    staticVideo.id = 'static-camera-feed';
    staticVideo.srcObject = stream;
    staticVideo.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
    staticVideo.setAttribute('autoplay', '');
    staticVideo.setAttribute('muted', '');
    
    // Style it to fill screen
    staticVideo.style.cssText = `
        position: fixed;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        z-index: 999;
        object-fit: cover;
    `;
    
    document.body.appendChild(staticVideo);
    console.log('📹 Static camera feed active');
}
```

**Dit is CRUCIAAL**: De statische feed verbergt de AR scene totdat een poster gevonden is. Dit voorkomt glitching!

---

## **CHUNK SCENE LOADING**

```javascript
function loadChunkScene(chunkIndex) {
    const chunk = window.arManifest.chunks[chunkIndex];
    if (!chunk) return;
    
    console.log(`📦 Loading Chunk ${chunkIndex}: ${chunk.file}`);
    
    // Remove existing scene
    const existingScene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    if (existingScene) existingScene.remove();
    
    // Build entities for all posters in this chunk
    // BELANGRIJK: targetIndex in HTML moet matchen met position in chunk!
    let entitiesHTML = '';
    chunk.posterIds.forEach((posterId, targetIndex) => {
        const poster = window.allPosters.find(p => p.id === posterId);
        if (poster) {
            const layersHTML = buildLayersHTML(poster);
            entitiesHTML += `
                <a-entity mindar-image-target="targetIndex: ${targetIndex}" 
                          data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
                    ${layersHTML}
                </a-entity>
            `;
        }
    });
    
    // Creëer scene met chunk URL (niet individuele poster URL!)
    const sceneHTML = `
        <a-scene
            id="ar-scene"
            mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: assets/chunks/${chunk.file}; 
                          filterMinCF: 0.0001; 
                          filterBeta: 0.001; 
                          warmupTolerance: 0; 
                          missTolerance: 2;"
            color-space="sRGB"
            renderer="colorManagement: true; physicallyCorrectLights: true;"
            vr-mode-ui="enabled: false"
            device-orientation-permission-ui="enabled: false">
            
            <a-camera position="0 0 0" look-controls="enabled: false"></a-camera>
            
            ${entitiesHTML}
        </a-scene>
    `;
    
    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', sceneHTML);
    
    // Setup event listeners
    const scene = document.getElementById('ar-scene');
    setupChunkEventListeners(scene, chunk);
}
```

**KEY DIFFERENCE NAAR NU**:
```javascript
// ❌ HUIDING (app.js huiging):
mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: ${poster.mindPath};"  // Individuele poster!

// ✅ DEC 4 (WERKTE GOED):
mindar-image="imageTargetSrc: assets/chunks/${chunk.file};"  // Chunk!
```

## **EVENT LISTENERS (Glitch Fix)**

```javascript
function setupChunkEventListeners(scene, chunk) {
    scene.addEventListener('arReady', () => {
        console.log('✅ Chunk AR Ready');
        
        // Verberg loader
        const loader = document.getElementById('arjs-loader');
        if (loader) loader.classList.add('hidden');
        
        // ASPECT RATIO FIX: Apply grayscale filter to video
        setTimeout(() => {
            document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
                v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            });
        }, 200);
    });
    
    // Listen for poster detection
    const targets = scene.querySelectorAll('[mindar-image-target]');
    targets.forEach(target => {
        target.addEventListener('targetFound', (e) => {
            const posterId = target.getAttribute('data-poster-id');
            const poster = window.allPosters.find(p => p.id === posterId);
            
            console.log(`🎯 Found poster: ${poster?.title}`);
            
            // REVEAL AR SCENE
            revealARScene();  // Hide static feed, show AR
            stopScanCycles('found');
            
            currentTrackedPoster = poster;
            showDetectedPosterState(poster);
        });
        
        target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
            console.log('🚫 Target lost');
            
            // HIDE AR SCENE
            hideARScene();   // Show static feed again
            hideDetectedPosterState();
            
            currentTrackedPoster = null;
            showScanButton('↻ Scan een andere poster');
        });
    });
}
```

## **SCANNING LOGIC (Multi-Chunk)**

```javascript
function startChunkScan() {
    if (isScanning) return;
    isScanning = true;
    
    let chunkIndex = window.currentChunkIndex;
    const totalChunks = window.arManifest.chunks.length;
    
    // Special case: slechts 1 chunk
    if (totalChunks === 1) {
        console.log('🔄 Single chunk reset/scan');
        loadChunkScene(0);
        updateScanningIndicator(null, 0, 1);
        
        // Toon "Scanning..." voor 2 seconden
        setTimeout(() => {
            stopScanCycles('complete');
            showScanButton('Scan');
        }, 2000);
        return;
    }
    
    // Rotate through chunks
    const nextChunk = () => {
        if (!isScanning) return;
        
        chunkIndex = (chunkIndex + 1) % totalChunks;
        window.currentChunkIndex = chunkIndex;
        
        // Load volgende chunk
        loadChunkScene(chunkIndex);
        updateScanningIndicator(null, chunkIndex, totalChunks);
        
        // Wacht 5 seconden, dan volgende chunk
        scannerInterval = setTimeout(nextChunk, 5000);
    };
    
    // Start rotation
    scannerInterval = setTimeout(nextChunk, 5000);
}
```

## **WAAROM DE HUIDGE VERSIE GLITCHT**

### **Probleem 1: Individuele .mind Files**

```javascript
// ❌ HUIDING:
for (const poster of validPosters) {
    const response = await fetch(poster.mindPath);  // poster_1.mind, poster_2.mind, etc
    // ...
}
```

**Gevolgen:**
- Elk poster zijn eigen MindAR controller
- Rapid scene switching = glitching video frames
- Geen statische feed om glitches te verbergen

### **Probleem 2: Geen Static Feed**

De huidge code initialiseert `staticCameraFeed()` maar verbergt het niet proper. Op Dec 4:

```javascript
// Dec 4: Statische feed VERBERGT de AR scene
const staticVideo = document.createElement('video');
staticVideo.style.cssText = `
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 999;  // BOVEN alles
    object-fit: cover;
`;
document.body.appendChild(staticVideo);

// Als poster gevonden:
revealARScene();  // Fade out static feed, show AR

// Als poster verloren:
hideARScene();    // Fade in static feed weer
```

### **Probleem 3: Aspect Ratio**

Er was code om video filters toe te passen:

```javascript
setTimeout(() => {
    document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene video').forEach((v) => {
        v.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
    });
}, 200);  // Na 200ms, na AR load
```

```
// Static camera feed overlay (hides the flickering AR scene)
let staticCameraStream = null;
let arSceneHidden = true; // AR scene starts hidden behind static feed

// ==================== VIDEO FILTER OBSERVER ====================
// Automatically apply grayscale filter to ALL video elements
function setupVideoFilterObserver() {
    const applyFilter = (video) => {
        if (!video.dataset.filterApplied) {
            video.style.filter = 'grayscale(100%) contrast(2.5) brightness(1)';
            video.dataset.filterApplied = 'true';
            console.log('🎨 Applied grayscale filter to video:', video.id || 'unnamed');
        }
    };
    
    // Apply to existing videos
    document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(applyFilter);
    
    // Watch for new videos
    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            mutation.addedNodes.forEach((node) => {
                if (node.nodeName === 'VIDEO') {
                    applyFilter(node);
                }
                if (node.querySelectorAll) {
                    node.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(applyFilter);
                }
            });
        });
    });
    
    observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    console.log('👁️ Video filter observer active');
}

// Force cleanup of WebGL contexts to prevent overflow
```

```
async function loadPosters() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('poster-grid');
    
    // If no poster grid, this function shouldn't be called (should use initFileManager instead)
    if (!grid) {
        console.log('ℹ️ No poster-grid found - file-manager.js likely handles this');
        return;
    }
    
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/posters`);
        if (!response.ok) {
            const errorText = await response.text();
            console.error('❌ API Error Response:', errorText);
            try {
                const errorJson = JSON.parse(errorText);
                console.error('❌ API Error Details:', errorJson);
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('❌ Raw Error:', errorText);
            }
            throw new Error('Kan posters niet laden: ' + response.status);
        }
        
        const posters = await response.json();
        displayPosters(posters);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error loading posters:', error);
        const grid = document.getElementById('poster-grid');
        if (grid) {
            grid.innerHTML = `
                <div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; padding: 3rem;">
                    <p style="color: #7f8c8d; font-size: 1.2rem;">
                        Geen posters gevonden. Start de server om posters te laden.
                    </p>
                </div>
            `;
        }
    }
}
```

// Display posters in grid
function displayPosters(posters) {
    const grid = document.getElementById('poster-grid');
    if (!grid) {
        console.log('ℹ️ No poster-grid found - file-manager.js likely handles this');
        return;
    }
    
    grid.innerHTML = posters.map(poster => {
        const imageUrl = poster.thumbnail ? `${BASE_URL}${poster.thumbnail}` : 'img/placeholder.png';
        const uploadDate = poster.upload_date || poster.uploadDate || poster.created_at;
        return `
        <div class="poster-card" data-poster-id="${poster.id}">
            <img class="poster-image" src="${imageUrl}" alt="${poster.title}" onerror="this.src='img/placeholder.png'">
            <div class="poster-info">
                <h3 class="poster-title">${poster.title}</h3>
                <p class="poster-date">${uploadDate ? new Date(uploadDate).toLocaleDateString('nl-NL') : ''}</p>
                <p class="poster-downloads">Downloads: ${poster.downloads || 0}</p>
            </div>
```

                    $layerData['is_video'] = false;

// ==================== LAYER VIDEO CONVERSION ====================

/**
 * Convert GIF to MP4 using FFmpeg
 * Returns true if successful, false if FFmpeg not available
 */
function convertGifToMp4($inputPath, $outputPath) {
    // Check if FFmpeg is available
    $ffmpegPath = trim(shell_exec('which ffmpeg 2>/dev/null')) ?: 'ffmpeg';
    
    if (!file_exists($inputPath)) {
        error_log("Input GIF not found: $inputPath");
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // FFmpeg command to convert GIF to MP4
        // -vf scale=1024:1024:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease - Scales max 1024x1024 keeping aspect
        // -c:v libx264 - H.264 codec (good compatibility)
        // -preset fast - Fast encoding
        // -b:v 2M - 2Mbps bitrate (good quality for small files)
        // -loop 0 - Loop infinitely
        $cmd = sprintf(
            '%s -i %s -c:v libx264 -preset fast -b:v 2M -vf "scale=1024:1024:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1024:1024:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2" -y %s 2>/dev/null',
            escapeshellarg($ffmpegPath),
            escapeshellarg($inputPath),
            escapeshellarg($outputPath)
        );
        
        $output = [];
        $returnCode = 0;
        @exec($cmd, $output, $returnCode);
        
        if ($returnCode === 0 && file_exists($outputPath)) {
            error_log("✅ Successfully converted GIF to MP4: $outputPath (" . filesize($outputPath) . " bytes)");
            return true;
        } else {
            error_log("❌ FFmpeg conversion failed (code $returnCode)");
            return false;
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("⚠️ GIF to MP4 conversion error: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

/**
 * Convert GIF to PNG (fallback if FFmpeg not available)
 * Uses ImageMagick or GD as fallback
 */
function convertGifToPng($inputPath, $outputPath) {
    try {
        // Try ImageMagick first (convert command)
        $convertPath = trim(shell_exec('which convert 2>/dev/null')) ?: 'convert';
        
        if (file_exists($convertPath) || shell_exec('which convert 2>/dev/null')) {
            $cmd = sprintf(
                'convert %s[0] -resize 1024x1024 %s 2>/dev/null',
                escapeshellarg($inputPath),
                escapeshellarg($outputPath)
            );
            
            $returnCode = 0;
            @exec($cmd, $output, $returnCode);
            
            if ($returnCode === 0 && file_exists($outputPath)) {
                error_log("✅ Converted GIF to PNG using ImageMagick: $outputPath");
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        // Fallback: Use GD if available
        if (extension_loaded('gd')) {
            $image = imagecreatefromgif($inputPath);
            if ($image !== false) {
                // Resize if needed
                $width = imagesx($image);
                $height = imagesy($image);
                
                if ($width > 1024 || $height > 1024) {
                    $ratio = min(1024 / $width, 1024 / $height);
                    $newWidth = (int)($width * $ratio);
                    $newHeight = (int)($height * $ratio);
                    
                    $resized = imagecreatetruecolor($newWidth, $newHeight);
                    imagecopyresampled($resized, $image, 0, 0, 0, 0, $newWidth, $newHeight, $width, $height);
                    imagepng($resized, $outputPath);
                    imagedestroy($resized);
                } else {
                    imagepng($image, $outputPath);
                }
                imagedestroy($image);
                
                error_log("✅ Converted GIF to PNG using GD: $outputPath");
                return true;
            }
        }
        
        // Last resort: just copy as PNG (won't work but at least we have a file)
        if (copy($inputPath, $outputPath)) {
            error_log("⚠️ Copied GIF as PNG (conversion unavailable): $outputPath");
            return true;
        }
        
        return false;
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("⚠️ GIF to PNG conversion error: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

                const mediaPath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';

                if (isVideo) {
                    // Use a-video for animated layers
                    layersHTML += `
                        <a-video 
                            id="ar-layer-${i}"
                            src="${mediaPath}" 
                            position="0 0 ${zPos}" 
                            height="1.4" 
                            width="1.4" 
                            rotation="0 0 0"
                            autoplay="true"
                            loop="true"
                            muted="true"
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-video>`;

                    // Use a-plane for static images
                    const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                    
                    layersHTML += `

                            src="${mediaPath}"

                            height="1.4" 
                            width="1.4" 
                            rotation="0 0 0"
                            data-image-src="${mediaPath}"

                            ${materialAttr}
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
                }
            }
        }
    }

- newString:

```
function buildLayersHTML(poster) {
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add black background layer - BEHIND all other layers (negative Z)
    // Make it larger than the poster to cover any gaps
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 -0.01" 
            height="2" 
            width="1.5" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double; shader: flat;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                // Base positioning
                const baseZ = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const posX = parseFloat(layerData.pos_x) || 0;
                const posY = parseFloat(layerData.pos_y) || 0;
                const posZ = baseZ;
                
                // Base scale/dimensions
                const width = parseFloat(layerData.width) || 1.4;
                const height = parseFloat(layerData.height) || 1.4;
                const rotZ = parseFloat(layerData.rot_z) || 0;
                
                // Animation data
                const hasAnimation = layerData.anim_duration && layerData.anim_duration > 0;
                let animationAttr = '';
                
                if (hasAnimation) {
                    // Build animation keyframes
                    const animDuration = layerData.anim_duration || 1000;
                    const animTimingMs = `${animDuration}ms`;
                    
                    // Create animation attributes for A-Frame
                    // Position animation
                    const posOffset = `${layerData.anim_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_y || 0} ${layerData.anim_z || 0}`;
                    
                    // Rotation animation
                    const rotOffset = `${layerData.anim_rot_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_y || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_z || 0}`;
                    
                    // Scale animation
                    const scaleTarget = layerData.anim_scale || 1.0;
                    
                    // Opacity animation
                    const opacityTarget = layerData.anim_opacity || 1.0;
                    
                    // Build animation attribute
                    animationAttr = `
                        animation="
                            property: position;
                            from: ${posX} ${posY} ${posZ};
                            to: ${posX + (layerData.anim_x || 0)} ${posY + (layerData.anim_y || 0)} ${posZ + (layerData.anim_z || 0)};
                            dur: ${animDuration};
                            easing: linear;
                            loop: true;
                            dir: alternate;
                        "
                        animation__rot="
                            property: rotation;
                            from: 0 0 ${rotZ};
                            to: ${layerData.anim_rot_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_y || 0} ${rotZ + (layerData.anim_rot_z || 0)};
                            dur: ${animDuration};
                            easing: linear;
                            loop: true;
                            dir: alternate;
                        "
                    `;
                    
                    // If there's scale animation, add it
                    if (scaleTarget !== 1.0) {
                        animationAttr += `
                        animation__scale="
                            property: scale;
                            from: 1 1 1;
                            to: ${scaleTarget} ${scaleTarget} ${scaleTarget};
                            dur: ${animDuration};
                            easing: linear;
                            loop: true;
                            dir: alternate;
                        "
                        `;
                    }
                    
                    // If there's opacity animation, add it
                    if (opacityTarget !== 1.0) {
                        animationAttr += `
                        animation__opacity="
                            property: components.material.material.opacity;
                            from: 1;
                            to: ${opacityTarget};
                            dur: ${animDuration};
                            easing: linear;
                            loop: true;
                            dir: alternate;
                        "
                        `;
                    }
                }
                
                const mediaPath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                
                // Check if it's a video (MP4, WebM) or image
                const isVideo = layerData.is_video === true || 
                               layerData.filename.endsWith('.mp4') || 
                               layerData.filename.endsWith('.webm');
                
                if (isVideo) {
                    // Use a-video for animated layers
                    layersHTML += `
                        <a-video 
                            id="ar-layer-${i}"
                            src="${mediaPath}" 
                            position="${posX} ${posY} ${posZ}" 
                            height="${height}" 
                            width="${width}" 
                            rotation="0 0 ${rotZ}"
                            autoplay="true"
                            loop="true"
                            muted="true"
                            ${animationAttr}
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-video>`;
                } else {
                    // Use a-plane for static images
                    const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                    
                    layersHTML += `
                        <a-plane 
                            id="ar-layer-${i}"
                            src="${mediaPath}" 
                            position="${posX} ${posY} ${posZ}" 
                            height="${height}" 
                            width="${width}" 
                            rotation="0 0 ${rotZ}"
                            data-image-src="${mediaPath}"
                            data-preserve-aspect="true"
                            ${materialAttr}
                            ${animationAttr}
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    return layersHTML;
}

                            data-image-src="${mediaPath}"
                            data-preserve-aspect="true"
                            ${materialAttr}
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    return layersHTML;
}
```

function buildLayersHTML(poster) {
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add black background layer - BEHIND all other layers (negative Z)
    // Make it larger than the poster to cover any gaps
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 -0.01" 
            height="2" 
            width="1.5" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double; shader: flat;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                // Base positioning
                const baseZ = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const posX = parseFloat(layerData.pos_x) || 0;
                const posY = parseFloat(layerData.pos_y) || 0;
                const posZ = baseZ;
                
                // Base scale (applies to both width and height proportionally)
                const baseScale = parseFloat(layerData.scale) || 1.0;
                const width = 1.4 * baseScale;  // Default width 1.4 * scale
                const height = 1.4 * baseScale;  // Default height 1.4 * scale (maintains ratio)
                const rotZ = parseFloat(layerData.rot_z) || 0;
                
                // Animation data
                const hasAnimation = layerData.anim_duration && layerData.anim_duration > 0;
                let animationAttr = '';
                
                if (hasAnimation) {
                    // Build animation keyframes
                    const animDuration = layerData.anim_duration || 1000;
                    
                    // Create animation attributes for A-Frame
                    // Position animation
                    const posOffset = `${layerData.anim_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_y || 0} ${layerData.anim_z || 0}`;
                    
                    // Rotation animation
                    const rotOffset = `${layerData.anim_rot_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_y || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_z || 0}`;
                    
                    // Scale animation
                    const scaleTarget = layerData.anim_scale || 1.0;
                    
                    // Opacity animation
                    const opacityTarget = layerData.anim_opacity || 1.0;
                    
                    // Build animation attribute with correct escaping
                    animationAttr = `
                        animation="property: position; from: ${posX} ${posY} ${posZ}; to: ${posX + (layerData.anim_x || 0)} ${posY + (layerData.anim_y || 0)} ${posZ + (layerData.anim_z || 0)}; dur: ${animDuration}; easing: linear; loop: true; dir: alternate;"
                        animation__rot="property: rotation; from: 0 0 ${rotZ}; to: ${layerData.anim_rot_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_y || 0} ${rotZ + (layerData.anim_rot_z || 0)}; dur: ${animDuration}; easing: linear; loop: true; dir: alternate;"
                    `;
                    
                    // If there's scale animation, add it
                    if (scaleTarget !== 1.0) {
                        animationAttr += `animation__scale="property: scale; from: 1 1 1; to: ${scaleTarget} ${scaleTarget} ${scaleTarget}; dur: ${animDuration}; easing: linear; loop: true; dir: alternate;"`;
                    }
                    
                    // If there's opacity animation, add it (more simplified approach)
                    if (opacityTarget !== 1.0) {
                        // Note: opacity animation on material needs special handling in A-Frame
                        animationAttr += ``;
                    }
                }
                
                const mediaPath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                
                // Check if it's a video (MP4, WebM) or image
                const isVideo = layerData.is_video === true || 
                               layerData.filename.endsWith('.mp4') || 
                               layerData.filename.endsWith('.webm');
                
                if (isVideo) {
                    // Use a-video for animated layers
                    layersHTML += `
                        <a-video 
                            id="ar-layer-${i}"
                            src="${mediaPath}" 
                            position="${posX} ${posY} ${posZ}" 
                            height="${height}" 
                            width="${width}" 
                            rotation="0 0 ${rotZ}"
                            autoplay="true"
                            loop="true"
                            muted="true"
                            ${animationAttr}
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-video>`;
                } else {
                    // Use a-plane for static images
                    const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                    
                    layersHTML += `
                        <a-plane 
                            id="ar-layer-${i}"
                            src="${mediaPath}" 
                            position="${posX} ${posY} ${posZ}" 
                            height="${height}" 
                            width="${width}" 
                            rotation="0 0 ${rotZ}"
                            data-image-src="${mediaPath}"
                            data-preserve-aspect="true"
                            ${materialAttr}
                            ${animationAttr}
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    return layersHTML;
}

                        const toPos = `${posX + animX} ${posY + animY} ${posZ + animZ}`;
                        animAttrs.push(`animation="property: position; from: ${fromPos}; to: ${toPos}; dur: ${dur}; easing: linear; loop: true; dir: alternate;"`);

```
function buildLayersHTML(poster) {
    let layersHTML = '';
    
    // Add black background layer - BEHIND all other layers (negative Z)
    // Make it larger than the poster to cover any gaps
    layersHTML += `
        <a-plane 
            id="ar-layer-0"
            position="0 0 -0.01" 
            height="2" 
            width="1.5" 
            rotation="0 0 0"
            material="color: #000000; transparent: false; side: double; shader: flat;"></a-plane>`;
    
    if (poster.layers) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
            const layerData = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
            
            if (layerData && layerData.filename) {
                // Base positioning
                const baseZ = Math.max(parseFloat(layerData.z) || 0, 0.1) + (i * 0.01);
                const posX = parseFloat(layerData.pos_x) || 0;
                const posY = parseFloat(layerData.pos_y) || 0;
                const posZ = baseZ;
                
                // Base scale (applies to both width and height proportionally)
                const baseScale = parseFloat(layerData.scale) || 1.0;
                const width = 1.4 * baseScale;  // Default width 1.4 * scale
                const height = 1.4 * baseScale;  // Default height 1.4 * scale (maintains ratio)
                const rotZ = parseFloat(layerData.rot_z) || 0;
                
                // Animation data
                const hasAnimation = layerData.anim_duration && layerData.anim_duration > 0;
                let animationAttr = '';
                
                if (hasAnimation) {
                    // Build animation keyframes
                    const animDuration = layerData.anim_duration || 1000;
                    
                    // Create animation attributes for A-Frame
                    // Position animation
                    const posOffset = `${layerData.anim_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_y || 0} ${layerData.anim_z || 0}`;
                    
                    // Rotation animation
                    const rotOffset = `${layerData.anim_rot_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_y || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_z || 0}`;
                    
                    // Scale animation
                    const scaleTarget = layerData.anim_scale || 1.0;
                    
                    // Opacity animation
                    const opacityTarget = layerData.anim_opacity || 1.0;
                    
                    // Build animation attribute with correct escaping
                    animationAttr = `
                        animation="property: position; from: ${posX} ${posY} ${posZ}; to: ${posX + (layerData.anim_x || 0)} ${posY + (layerData.anim_y || 0)} ${posZ + (layerData.anim_z || 0)}; dur: ${animDuration}; easing: linear; loop: true; dir: alternate;"
                        animation__rot="property: rotation; from: 0 0 ${rotZ}; to: ${layerData.anim_rot_x || 0} ${layerData.anim_rot_y || 0} ${rotZ + (layerData.anim_rot_z || 0)}; dur: ${animDuration}; easing: linear; loop: true; dir: alternate;"
                    `;
                    
                    // If there's scale animation, add it
                    if (scaleTarget !== 1.0) {
                        animationAttr += `animation__scale="property: scale; from: 1 1 1; to: ${scaleTarget} ${scaleTarget} ${scaleTarget}; dur: ${animDuration}; easing: linear; loop: true; dir: alternate;"`;
                    }
                    
                    // If there's opacity animation, add it (more simplified approach)
                    if (opacityTarget !== 1.0) {
                        // Note: opacity animation on material needs special handling in A-Frame
                        animationAttr += ``;
                    }
                }
                
                const mediaPath = `uploads/ar-layers/${layerData.filename}`;
                const exclusionAttr = layerData.exclusion_filter ? `data-exclusion="true"` : '';
                
                // Check if it's a video (MP4, WebM) or image
                const isVideo = layerData.is_video === true || 
                               layerData.filename.endsWith('.mp4') || 
                               layerData.filename.endsWith('.webm');
                
                if (isVideo) {
                    // Use a-video for animated layers
                    layersHTML += `
                        <a-video 
                            id="ar-layer-${i}"
                            src="${mediaPath}" 
                            position="${posX} ${posY} ${posZ}" 
                            height="${height}" 
                            width="${width}" 
                            rotation="0 0 ${rotZ}"
                            autoplay="true"
                            loop="true"
                            muted="true"
                            ${animationAttr}
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-video>`;
                } else {
                    // Use a-plane for static images
                    const materialAttr = `material="transparent: true; alphaTest: 0.1; side: double;"`;
                    
                    layersHTML += `
                        <a-plane 
                            id="ar-layer-${i}"
                            src="${mediaPath}" 
                            position="${posX} ${posY} ${posZ}" 
                            height="${height}" 
                            width="${width}" 
                            rotation="0 0 ${rotZ}"
                            data-image-src="${mediaPath}"
                            data-preserve-aspect="true"
                            ${materialAttr}
                            ${animationAttr}
                            ${exclusionAttr}></a-plane>`;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!layersHTML.includes('ar-layer-1')) {
        layersHTML += `<a-box position="0 0 0.1" color="#FF0000" width="0.2" height="0.2" depth="0.2"></a-box>`;
    }
    
    return layersHTML;
}

+// Debug helper: log current AR layer DOM nodes and video readiness
+function logLayerElements(context = 'arReady') {
+    const layers = document.querySelectorAll('#ar-scene [id^="ar-layer-"]');
+    const summary = [];
+
+    layers.forEach((el) => {
+        const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
+        const src = el.getAttribute('src') || el.getAttribute('data-image-src');
+        const isVideo = tag === 'a-video';
+        let videoState = null;
+
+        if (isVideo) {
+            const materialSrc = el.components?.material?.data?.src;
+            const videoEl = materialSrc?.el || document.querySelector(`#${el.id} video`);
+            if (videoEl) {
+                videoState = {
+                    readyState: videoEl.readyState,
+                    paused: videoEl.paused,
+                    currentTime: Number(videoEl.currentTime?.toFixed?.(2) || videoEl.currentTime || 0),
+                    autoplay: videoEl.autoplay,
+                    loop: videoEl.loop,
+                    muted: videoEl.muted,
+                    src: videoEl.currentSrc || videoEl.src
+                };
+            }
+        }
+
+        summary.push({
+            id: el.id,
+            tag,
+            src,
+            isVideo,
+            dataset: {
+                customScale: el.getAttribute('data-custom-scale'),
+                exclusion: el.dataset?.exclusion
+            },
+            videoState
+        });
+    });
+
+    console.log(`🧾 Layer DOM snapshot (${context})`, summary);
