// ========== Client-side GIF → MP4 conversion (ffmpeg.wasm) ==========
// Mark GIFs for server-side processing with a special MIME type hint
async function convertGifFileToMp4(file, label = 'layer') {
    if (file.type !== 'image/gif') {
        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] File is not GIF, skipping conversion: ${file.name}`);
        return file;
    }
    
    console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Processing GIF: ${file.name} (${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`);
    
    // Try ffmpeg.wasm approach
    try {
        // Check if FFmpeg is available globally
        if (!window.FFmpeg) {
            console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Loading FFmpeg.wasm from CDN...`);
            await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const script = document.createElement('script');
                script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ffmpeg/ffmpeg@0.12.6/dist/ffmpeg.min.js';
                script.async = true;
                script.onload = () => {
                    console.log(`[GIF→MP4] FFmpeg.wasm loaded`);
                    resolve();
                };
                script.onerror = () => {
                    console.warn(`[GIF→MP4] Failed to load FFmpeg.wasm from CDN`);
                    reject(new Error('FFmpeg CDN not available'));
                };
                script.timeout = 10000; // 10s timeout
                document.head.appendChild(script);
            });
        }

        const { createFFmpeg, fetchFile } = window.FFmpeg;
        if (!createFFmpeg) {
            throw new Error('FFmpeg not properly loaded');
        }

        const ffmpeg = createFFmpeg({ log: false });
        
        if (!ffmpeg.isLoaded()) {
            console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Initializing FFmpeg...`);
            await ffmpeg.load();
        }

        const inputName = `${label}.gif`;
        const outputName = `${label}.mp4`;

        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Writing GIF to FFmpeg filesystem...`);
        ffmpeg.FS('writeFile', inputName, await fetchFile(file));
        
        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Running FFmpeg conversion...`);
        await ffmpeg.run(
            '-i', inputName,
            '-movflags', 'faststart',
            '-vf', 'scale=1024:1024:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1024:1024:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2',
            '-c:v', 'libx264',
            '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p',
            '-preset', 'veryfast',
            '-crf', '28',
            '-an',
            '-t', '10', // Limit to 10 seconds to avoid huge files
            '-y', outputName
        );
        
        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Reading converted MP4...`);
        const data = ffmpeg.FS('readFile', outputName);
        const mp4File = new File([data.buffer], `${label}.mp4`, { type: 'video/mp4' });
        
        // Cleanup
        try {
            ffmpeg.FS('unlink', inputName);
            ffmpeg.FS('unlink', outputName);
        } catch (e) {}

        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] ✅ Conversion succeeded: ${(mp4File.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`);
        return mp4File;
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`[GIF→MP4] ⚠️ Client-side conversion failed (${e.message}), will send as MP4 with GIF data and let server handle it`);
        
        // Create a fake MP4 file with GIF data—server will detect and re-encode
        const mp4File = new File([file], `${label}.mp4`, { type: 'video/mp4' });
        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Created placeholder MP4 (actually GIF): ${mp4File.name}`);
        return mp4File;
    }
}
```

    if (ffmpegInstance) return ffmpegInstance;
    const { createFFmpeg } = window.FFmpeg;
    ffmpegInstance = createFFmpeg({ log: false });
    await ffmpegInstance.load();
    return ffmpegInstance;
}

async function convertGifFileToMp4(file, label = 'layer') {
    try {
        const ffmpeg = await getFfmpeg();
        const { fetchFile } = window.FFmpeg;
        const inputName = `${label}.gif`;
        const outputName = `${label}.mp4`;

        ffmpeg.FS('writeFile', inputName, await fetchFile(file));
        await ffmpeg.run(
            '-i', inputName,
            '-movflags', 'faststart',
            '-vf', 'scale=1024:1024:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1024:1024:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2',
            '-c:v', 'libx264',
            '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p',
            '-preset', 'fast',
            '-crf', '23',
            '-an',
            '-y', outputName
        );
        const data = ffmpeg.FS('readFile', outputName);
        ffmpeg.FS('unlink', inputName);
        ffmpeg.FS('unlink', outputName);

        return new File([data.buffer], `${label}.mp4`, { type: 'video/mp4' });
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('GIF→MP4 conversion failed, fallback to server handling:', e);
        return file; // Fallback: let server attempt
    }
}

function convertGifToMp4($inputPath, $outputPath) {
    // Check if FFmpeg is available
    $ffmpegPath = trim(shell_exec('which ffmpeg 2>/dev/null')) ?: 'ffmpeg';
    
    error_log("[FFMPEG] Attempting conversion: $inputPath → $outputPath");
    
    if (!$ffmpegPath || !shell_exec("which ffmpeg 2>/dev/null")) {
        error_log("[FFMPEG] ffmpeg NOT FOUND in PATH - trying fallback");
        $ffmpegPath = 'ffmpeg'; // Fallback to system PATH
    } else {
        error_log("[FFMPEG] ffmpeg found at: $ffmpegPath");
    }
    
    if (!file_exists($inputPath)) {
        error_log("[FFMPEG] Input file not found: $inputPath");
        return false;
    }
    
    // Get file info to detect what it really is
    $finfo = finfo_open(FILEINFO_MIME_TYPE);
    $realMime = finfo_file($finfo, $inputPath);
    finfo_close($finfo);
    error_log("[FFMPEG] Real MIME type of input: $realMime");
    
    try {
        // FFmpeg command to convert GIF to MP4
        $cmd = sprintf(
            '%s -i %s -movflags faststart -vf "scale=1024:1024:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1024:1024:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2" -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -preset veryfast -crf 28 -an -t 10 -y %s 2>&1',
            escapeshellarg($ffmpegPath),
            escapeshellarg($inputPath),
            escapeshellarg($outputPath)
        );
        
        error_log("[FFMPEG] Command: $cmd");
        
        $output = [];
        $returnCode = 0;
        @exec($cmd, $output, $returnCode);
        
        $fullOutput = implode("\n", $output);
        
        if ($returnCode === 0 && file_exists($outputPath)) {
            $fileSize = filesize($outputPath);
            error_log("✅ [FFMPEG] Successfully converted: $outputPath ($fileSize bytes)");
            return true;
        } else {
            error_log("❌ [FFMPEG] Conversion failed (return code: $returnCode)");
            error_log("[FFMPEG] Output:\n$fullOutput");
            return false;
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("❌ [FFMPEG] Exception: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }
}

    if (!$ffmpegPath) {
        error_log("[FFMPEG] ffmpeg not found in PATH");
    }
    
    if (!file_exists($inputPath)) {
        error_log("Input GIF not found: $inputPath");
        return false;
    }
    
    try {
        // FFmpeg command to convert GIF to MP4
        // -vf scale=1024:1024:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease - Scales max 1024x1024 keeping aspect
        // -c:v libx264 - H.264 codec (good compatibility)
        // -preset fast - Fast encoding
        // -b:v 2M - 2Mbps bitrate (good quality for small files)
        // -loop 0 - Loop infinitely
        $cmd = sprintf(
            '%s -i %s -c:v libx264 -preset fast -b:v 2M -vf "scale=1024:1024:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1024:1024:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2" -y %s 2>/dev/null',
            escapeshellarg($ffmpegPath),
            escapeshellarg($inputPath),
            escapeshellarg($outputPath)
        );
        error_log("[FFMPEG] Command: $cmd");
        
        $output = [];
        $returnCode = 0;
        @exec($cmd, $output, $returnCode);
        
        if ($returnCode === 0 && file_exists($outputPath)) {
            error_log("✅ Successfully converted GIF to MP4: $outputPath (" . filesize($outputPath) . " bytes)");
            return true;
        } else {
            error_log("❌ FFmpeg conversion failed (code $returnCode) for $inputPath → $outputPath");
            return false;
        }
    } catch (Exception $e) {
        error_log("⚠️ GIF to MP4 conversion error: " . $e->getMessage());
        return false;
    }

```
// ========== Client-side GIF → MP4 conversion (ffmpeg.wasm) ==========
// Mark GIFs for server-side processing with a special MIME type hint
async function convertGifFileToMp4(file, label = 'layer') {
    if (file.type !== 'image/gif') {
        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] File is not GIF, skipping conversion: ${file.name}`);
        return file;
    }
    
    console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Processing GIF: ${file.name} (${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`);
    
    // Try ffmpeg.wasm approach
    try {
        // Check if FFmpeg is available globally
        if (!window.FFmpeg) {
            console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Loading FFmpeg.wasm from CDN...`);
            await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                const script = document.createElement('script');
                script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@ffmpeg/ffmpeg@0.12.6/dist/ffmpeg.min.js';
                script.async = true;
                script.onload = () => {
                    console.log(`[GIF→MP4] FFmpeg.wasm loaded`);
                    resolve();
                };
                script.onerror = () => {
                    console.warn(`[GIF→MP4] Failed to load FFmpeg.wasm from CDN`);
                    reject(new Error('FFmpeg CDN not available'));
                };
                script.timeout = 10000; // 10s timeout
                document.head.appendChild(script);
            });
        }

        const { createFFmpeg, fetchFile } = window.FFmpeg;
        if (!createFFmpeg) {
            throw new Error('FFmpeg not properly loaded');
        }

        const ffmpeg = createFFmpeg({ log: false });
        
        if (!ffmpeg.isLoaded()) {
            console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Initializing FFmpeg...`);
            await ffmpeg.load();
        }

        const inputName = `${label}.gif`;
        const outputName = `${label}.mp4`;

        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Writing GIF to FFmpeg filesystem...`);
        ffmpeg.FS('writeFile', inputName, await fetchFile(file));
        
        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Running FFmpeg conversion...`);
        await ffmpeg.run(
            '-i', inputName,
            '-movflags', 'faststart',
            '-vf', 'scale=1024:1024:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1024:1024:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2',
            '-c:v', 'libx264',
            '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p',
            '-preset', 'veryfast',
            '-crf', '28',
            '-an',
            '-t', '10', // Limit to 10 seconds to avoid huge files
            '-y', outputName
        );
        
        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Reading converted MP4...`);
        const data = ffmpeg.FS('readFile', outputName);
        const mp4File = new File([data.buffer], `${label}.mp4`, { type: 'video/mp4' });
        
        // Cleanup
        try {
            ffmpeg.FS('unlink', inputName);
            ffmpeg.FS('unlink', outputName);
        } catch (e) {}

        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] ✅ Conversion succeeded: ${(mp4File.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`);
        return mp4File;
        
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn(`[GIF→MP4] ⚠️ Client-side conversion failed (${e.message}), will send as MP4 with GIF data and let server handle it`);
        
        // Create a fake MP4 file with GIF data—server will detect and re-encode
        const mp4File = new File([file], `${label}.mp4`, { type: 'video/mp4' });
        console.log(`[GIF→MP4] Created placeholder MP4 (actually GIF): ${mp4File.name}`);
        return mp4File;
    }
}

There is a lib that solve our problem with A-Frame and GIFs:
https://github.com/mayognaise/aframe-gif-shader
This lib was developed by Mayognaise and it has a problem to show GIFs with transparent background, not having a flush between each draw of frame.
However Tinchoforever fixed this in his project Belisario and proposed a pull request to Mayognaise(Which was not accepted yet on this moment), so we are using this version of the GIF shader:
https://github.com/tinchoforever/belisario.com.ar/blob/master/scripts/aframe-gif-shader.js

// A-Frame GIF Shader
// Based on: https://github.com/tinchoforever/belisario.com.ar/blob/master/scripts/aframe-gif-shader.js
// Supports transparent GIFs in A-Frame

if (typeof AFRAME === 'undefined') {
  throw new Error('Component attempted to register before AFRAME was available.');
}

AFRAME.registerShader('gif', {
  schema: {
    src: { type: 'map', is: 'uniform' }
  },

  init: function (data) {
    this.canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext('2d');
    this.images = [];
    this.texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(this.canvas);
    this.texture.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
    this.texture.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
    this.frameIndex = 0;
    this.frameDelay = 0;
    this.currentFrameDelay = 0;
    this.isPlaying = true;
    this.isLoaded = false;
    this.material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: this.texture });
  },

  update: function (data) {
    var self = this;
    var src = data.src;

    if (!src) {
      return;
    }

    if (typeof src === 'string') {
      // Load image from URL
      var img = new Image();
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      img.onload = function () {
        self.loadGif(img);
      };
      img.onerror = function () {
        console.error('Failed to load GIF:', src);
      };
      img.src = src;
    } else if (src instanceof HTMLImageElement) {
      this.loadGif(src);
    }
  },

  loadGif: function (img) {
    var self = this;
    var gif = new GIF({
      workers: 2,
      quality: 10,
      width: img.width,
      height: img.height,
      workerScript: 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gif.js@0.2.0/dist/gif.worker.js'
    });

    gif.on('finished', function (blob) {
      var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      var video = document.createElement('video');
      video.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      video.src = url;
      video.loop = true;
      video.play();

      self.material.map = new THREE.VideoTexture(video);
      self.material.map.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
      self.material.map.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;

      if (self.el.components.material) {
        self.el.components.material.material = self.material;
      }
    });

    // Alternatively, use simple canvas-based GIF playback
    try {
      var gif_js = new GifReader(new Uint8Array(this.arrayBuffer));
      self.canvas.width = gif_js.width;
      self.canvas.height = gif_js.height;

      self.frameCount = gif_js.numFrames();
      self.delays = [];

      for (var i = 0; i < self.frameCount; i++) {
        var info = gif_js.frameInfo(i);
        self.delays.push(info.delay);
      }

      self.isLoaded = true;
      self.animate();
    } catch (e) {
      // Fallback: use gif.js library
      self.useGifLib(img);
    }
  },

  useGifLib: function (img) {
    var self = this;

    // Load gif.js library dynamically
    var script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gif.js@0.2.0/dist/gif.js';
    script.onload = function () {
      var gif = new GIF({
        workers: 2,
        quality: 10,
        width: img.width,
        height: img.height
      });

      gif.on('finished', function (blob) {
        var url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        var video = document.createElement('video');
        video.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
        video.src = url;
        video.loop = true;
        video.autoplay = true;
        video.play();

        self.material.map = new THREE.VideoTexture(video);
        self.material.map.magFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
        self.material.map.minFilter = THREE.NearestFilter;
        self.material.needsUpdate = true;

        if (self.el.components.material) {
          self.el.components.material.material = self.material;
        }
      });

      gif.render();
    };
    document.head.appendChild(script);
  },

  animate: function () {
    var self = this;

    if (!this.isLoaded || !this.isPlaying) {
      requestAnimationFrame(function () {
        self.animate();
      });
      return;
    }

    this.currentFrameDelay += 16; // 60fps

    if (this.currentFrameDelay >= (this.delays[this.frameIndex] || 100)) {
      this.currentFrameDelay = 0;

      // Draw frame
      var imageData = new ImageData(
        new Uint8ClampedArray(this.arrayBuffer),
        this.canvas.width,
        this.canvas.height
      );
      this.ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);
      this.texture.needsUpdate = true;

      // Next frame
      this.frameIndex = (this.frameIndex + 1) % this.frameCount;
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      self.animate();
    });
  }
});

There is a lib that solve our problem with A-Frame and GIFs:
https://github.com/mayognaise/aframe-gif-shader
This lib was developed by Mayognaise and it has a problem to show GIFs with transparent background, not having a flush between each draw of frame.
However Tinchoforever fixed this in his project Belisario and proposed a pull request to Mayognaise(Which was not accepted yet on this moment), so we are using this version of the GIF shader:

**Examining Error Reports**

I'm currently reviewing a series of error reports. The primary issue seems to be a content type mismatch, specifically concerning a JavaScript file from a CDN. The browser is refusing to execute the script due to the "X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff" header. This looks to be preventing the browser from interpreting the file correctly.


**Investigating the Errors**

I'm now diving deeper into the reported errors. It's clear that the CDN-hosted JavaScript files for `gif.js` and `gifframeparser.js` are the source of the initial issues, with the browser refusing to execute them due to content type restrictions. I'll need to locally source these scripts to sidestep the problem. The `THREE.Math` issue is also quite clear. The A-Frame component needs an upgrade to align with the latest Three.js versions.

    // Listen for ANY target found
    const targets = scene.querySelectorAll('[mindar-image-target]');
    targets.forEach(target => {
        target.addEventListener('targetFound', (e) => {
            const posterId = target.getAttribute('data-poster-id');
            const poster = window.allPosters.find(p => p.id === posterId);
            console.log(`🎯 Found poster: ${poster?.title}`);
            
            revealARScene();
            stopScanCycles('found');
            
            currentTrackedPoster = poster;
            showDetectedPosterState(poster);
            
            // Check if we need to show loader for GIFs
            checkAndShowLoader(poster);
        });
        
        target.addEventListener('targetLost', () => {
            console.log('🚫 Target lost');
            hideARScene();
            hideDetectedPosterState();
            currentTrackedPoster = null;
            showScanButton('↻ Scan een andere poster');
            hideHackerLoader(); // Always hide loader when target lost
        });
    });
}

function checkAndShowLoader(poster) {
    if (!poster || !poster.layers) return;
    
    let hasPendingGif = false;
    
    for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
        const layer = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
        if (layer && layer.filename && layer.filename.endsWith('.gif')) {
            // Construct the full path as used in the shader
            // Note: The shader might receive the full URL or relative path depending on how it was set
            // We check if the filename is in our loaded set (loosely)
            const filename = layer.filename;
            const isLoaded = Array.from(loadedGifs).some(src => src.includes(filename));
            
            if (!isLoaded) {
                hasPendingGif = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (hasPendingGif) {
        showHackerLoader();
    }
}

function checkAndHideLoader(poster) {
    if (!poster || !poster.layers) {
        hideHackerLoader();
        return;
    }
    
    let allLoaded = true;
    
    for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
        const layer = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
        if (layer && layer.filename && layer.filename.endsWith('.gif')) {
            const filename = layer.filename;
            const isLoaded = Array.from(loadedGifs).some(src => src.includes(filename));
            
            if (!isLoaded) {
                allLoaded = false;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (allLoaded) {
        hideHackerLoader();
    }
}

// Chunk Scanning Logic

**Envisioning the Interface**

I've confirmed the GIF is playing, excellent! Now, I'm focusing on the AR content loading. The challenge is a hacker-esque loading indicator: clean, understated, not flashy. I'm exploring subtle animations to show progress, keeping the style consistent with the desktop version but adapted for a cleaner, less exuberant aesthetic.


**Examining App.js**

I'm now diving deep into `app.js`. The `gif-loaded` event is clear, and the functions are all there. My next step is pinpointing the best place to insert the loading indicator logic – perhaps within `initializeARMode` or `buildLayersHTML`. I'm leaning towards the latter, as it seems directly tied to content creation and subsequent loading.


**Refining Loader Mechanics**

I'm now contemplating where and how to trigger the loader's visibility. I'll need to listen for the `targetFound` event, then hide the loader when a GIF has finished loading. Multiple posters mean I can't hide it immediately on `gif-loaded` because another may still be loading. Considering this, I might need to show a more general "Loading assets..." message until all AR content is ready. Thinking through the implications for multiple concurrent loads, and the events that would need to be considered.


**Developing the Overlay**

I'm now building the HTML for the hacker-style loader, aiming for a fixed overlay centered on the screen. The CSS includes a monospace font, green text, and a blinking cursor. After creating the HTML elements for the loader, I'll then move on to adding the CSS to style it. My plan is now to make the loader hidden by default. I have checked the overall structure of the HTML, and will be using a simple approach to show and hide the loader when the appropriate events are triggered.


**Defining State Management**

My thoughts now revolve around a global `window.loadedGifs` set to track which GIFs have finished loading. This way, the loader will only appear for new targets with unloaded content. I am planning to implement the loading indication's visibility based on the `targetFound` event, coupled with checking this set to avoid repeatedly showing a loading screen.


**Structuring the Logic**

I'm now outlining how to trigger the loader. A global set, `window.loadedGifs`, will track loaded GIFs. In `gif-loaded`, I'll add the `src` to this set. When `targetFound` fires, I'll check if the target's GIFs are in the set; if not, the loader appears. The plan now focuses on integrating the loader's visibility checks within the established event structure.

function checkAndShowLoader(poster) {
    if (!poster || !poster.layers) return;
    
    let hasGifLayer = false;
    let allGifsLoaded = true;
    
    // First, check if there are any GIF layers at all
    for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
        const layer = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
        if (layer && layer.filename && layer.filename.endsWith('.gif')) {
            hasGifLayer = true;
            const filename = layer.filename;
            const isLoaded = Array.from(loadedGifs).some(src => src.includes(filename));
            
            if (!isLoaded) {
                allGifsLoaded = false;
                console.log(`⏳ Pending GIF: ${filename}`);
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (hasGifLayer) {
        // Always show loader initially for effect and feedback
        showHackerLoader();
        
        if (allGifsLoaded) {
            console.log('✅ All GIFs already ready. Hiding loader shortly...');
            // Give a small delay so the user sees the "Decrypting" effect
            setTimeout(() => {
                // Only hide if we are still tracking the same poster
                if (currentTrackedPoster && currentTrackedPoster.id === poster.id) {
                    hideHackerLoader();
                }
            }, 800);
        } else {
            console.log('⏳ Waiting for GIFs to load...');
        }
    }
}
```

function checkAndShowLoader(poster) {
    if (!poster || !poster.layers) return;
    
    let hasPendingGif = false;
    
    for (let i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
        const layer = poster.layers[`layer_${i}`];
        if (layer && layer.filename && layer.filename.endsWith('.gif')) {
            const filename = layer.filename;
            // Check if ANY loaded GIF path contains this filename
            const isLoaded = Array.from(loadedGifs).some(src => src.includes(filename));
            
            if (!isLoaded) {
                console.log(`⏳ Pending GIF: ${filename}`);
                hasPendingGif = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (hasPendingGif) {
        console.log('⏳ Showing loader for pending GIFs...');
        showHackerLoader();
    } else {
        console.log('✅ All GIFs ready, no loader needed.');
    }
}

**Assessing the Logs**

I'm examining the logs provided. It seems the loader should not have appeared, since all GIFs were ready before the relevant function call. This implies the problem lies either in the loader's visibility logic or in a timing issue. The `checkAndShowLoader` function's behavior needs closer scrutiny.


**Revisiting Event Ordering**

I'm reconsidering the sequence of events. The logs show the GIF loaded before the poster was found. This is problematic, suggesting a potential race condition. Either the `gif-loaded` event is firing too early, or the poster's detection is delayed. I must investigate how `gif-loaded` is triggered to ensure it aligns with the actual loading process.


**Evaluating Visibility Timing**

The logs confirm that GIF loading precedes target detection, explaining the missing loader. The GIF is ready before the AR system finds the poster, preventing the loader from appearing. The "visible=false" removal is now suspect, as the shader's initial state is unclear. Perhaps the GIF takes time to become *playable* after "ready." The user might be experiencing slower loading times, leading to the perception of later functionality.


**Considering User Feedback**

I'm now focusing on user feedback that the loader remains unseen. The logs indicate GIFs are ready *before* target detection, bypassing the loader. The key point is: even after the "fix," the problem persists. Since GIFs should be visible, any delay would likely come from the AR system or shader initialization, but if the GIF works later, then the shader is the root cause. This confirms the initial thought - perhaps I can make it always show, then make it hide after the GIF is ready, for the "hacker" effect.


**Re-Evaluating User Expectations**

I'm focused on the user's desire for a loader, despite the logs showing GIFs are often ready before poster detection. The logs show assets loading at DOM ready, so GIFs pre-load. I see a need for the "hacker" experience: a loader even when technically unnecessary. This reveals a misunderstanding of how the AR system loads assets, so the user might *want* the perceived delay. My strategy needs adjustment.


**Reconsidering the "Cool Effect"**

I'm focused on the user's desire for a loading effect. Log analysis reveals GIFs often load before the poster is found. A-Frame's preload behavior is key. If the user expects a delay and the app's speed prevents it, I need to force the loader's visibility for the desired "hacker" effect.


**Refining Loader Visibility Logic**

My updated plan is to always show the loader when a target is detected, if a GIF is present, and only hide it if the GIF is already loaded or after a short delay for aesthetic effect. This approach aims to address the user's desire for visual feedback and the "hacker effect," guaranteeing the loader's appearance regardless of the GIF's loading status. I'll also carefully verify the population of the `loadedGifs` set.


**Finalizing Loader Strategy**

I'm implementing the new logic. The plan is to immediately show the loader when a target is detected, if it has a GIF layer. Then, if the GIF is already loaded, I'll hide the loader after a short delay for the "hacker" effect. If the GIF is still loading, the loader will remain visible until the `gif-loaded` event fires. ```
/* Hacker Loader - Boot Sequence */
#hacker-loader {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 100px; /* Above the bottom nav/buttons */
    left: 20px;
    width: 300px;
    max-width: calc(100% - 40px);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
    border-left: 2px solid #00ff00;
    padding: 10px 15px;
    color: #00ff00;
    font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    z-index: 10000;
    pointer-events: none;
    display: none; /* Hidden by default, toggled by JS */
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.1);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    overflow: hidden;
}

#hacker-loader.visible {
    display: block !important;
}

#loader-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.log-line {
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeIn 0.2s forwards;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.log-line.success { color: #00ff00; }
.log-line.warning { color: #ffff00; }
.log-line.error { color: #ff0000; }

@keyframes fadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.blink-cursor {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 8px;
    height: 14px;
    background: #00ff00;
    animation: blink 1s step-end infinite;
    vertical-align: middle;
    margin-left: 5px;
}

@keyframes blink {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0; }
}
```

```
// Main.js - AR.js Version (iOS Compatible)

// ==================== HACKER LOADER LOGIC ====================
function logToLoader(msg, type = 'info') {
    const loaderContent = document.getElementById('loader-content');
    if (!loaderContent) return;
    
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = `log-line ${type}`;
    line.textContent = `> ${msg}`;
    
    loaderContent.appendChild(line);
    
    // Auto scroll
    const loader = document.getElementById('hacker-loader');
    if (loader) loader.scrollTop = loader.scrollHeight;
    
    // Limit lines
    while (loaderContent.children.length > 8) {
        loaderContent.removeChild(loaderContent.firstChild);
    }
}

function hideLoader() {
    const loader = document.getElementById('hacker-loader');
    if (loader) {
        logToLoader('SYSTEM_READY', 'success');
        setTimeout(() => {
            loader.classList.remove('visible');
        }, 1000);
    }
}

// Hook console.log to feed the loader
const originalLog = console.log;
console.log = function(...args) {
    originalLog.apply(console, args);
    const msg = args.join(' ');
    // Filter for relevant emojis or keywords
    if (msg.match(/🚀|📡|✅|📦|📄|🔍|📊|🎯|🎨|🧹|👁️|🔄|🧱|🎬|🛑|🚫|🙈/)) {
        logToLoader(msg.replace(/[\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}]/gu, '').trim()); // Strip emoji for hacker look? Or keep them? Let's keep text clean.
        // Actually, let's keep the emoji, it adds character, or strip if user wants "clean hacker".
        // User said "hacker achtig". Emojis are not very hacker.
        // Let's strip emojis for the loader display.
    }
};

// API Configuration
const API_URL = window.location.origin + '/api.php'; // cPanel with PHP backend
```

function showGifLoader() {
    // Re-using the same loader for GIF loading feedback
    const loader = document.getElementById('hacker-loader');

        loader.classList.add('visible');

/* System Loader - Integrated Style */
#hacker-loader {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background: var(--black, #000000);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--white, #ffffff);
    padding: 8px 15px;
    color: var(--white, #ffffff);
    font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    z-index: 10000;
    pointer-events: none;
    display: none; /* Hidden by default */
    text-transform: uppercase;
    height: 40px; /* Fixed height bar */
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

#hacker-loader.visible {
    display: flex !important;
}

#loader-content {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex: 1;
}

.log-line {
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeIn 0.2s forwards;
    color: #888; /* Dimmed history */
}

.log-line:last-child {
    color: var(--white, #ffffff); /* Active line white */
    font-weight: bold;
}

/* Status Indicator */
.loader-status {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    color: #af1d1f; /* Site Red */
    font-weight: bold;
    padding-left: 15px;
    border-left: 1px solid #333;
}

.blink-cursor {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 6px;
    height: 10px;
    background: #af1d1f; /* Site Red */
    animation: blink 1s step-end infinite;
}

@keyframes blink {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0; }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(2px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
```

/* Hacker Loader - Boot Sequence */
#hacker-loader {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 100px; /* Above the bottom nav/buttons */
    left: 20px;
    width: 300px;
    max-width: calc(100% - 40px);
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);
    border-left: 2px solid #00ff00;
    padding: 10px 15px;
    color: #00ff00;
    font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    z-index: 10000;
    pointer-events: none;
    display: none; /* Hidden by default, toggled by JS */
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.1);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    overflow: hidden;
}

#hacker-loader.visible {
    display: block !important;
}

#loader-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
}

.log-line {
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeIn 0.2s forwards;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.log-line.success { color: #00ff00; }
.log-line.warning { color: #ffff00; }
.log-line.error { color: #ff0000; }

@keyframes fadeIn {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(5px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.blink-cursor {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 8px;
    height: 14px;
    background: #00ff00;
    animation: blink 1s step-end infinite;
    vertical-align: middle;
    margin-left: 5px;
}

@keyframes blink {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0; }
}

// ==================== SYSTEM LOADER LOGIC (DUTCH) ====================
const logQueue = [];
let isProcessingQueue = false;

function updateLoaderStatus(status) {
    const statusEl = document.querySelector('.loader-status span:first-child');
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = status;
}

function processLogQueue() {
    if (logQueue.length === 0) return;
    
    const msg = logQueue.shift();
    const loaderContent = document.getElementById('loader-content');
    if (!loaderContent) return;
    
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'log-line';
    line.textContent = `> ${msg}`;
    
    loaderContent.appendChild(line);
    loaderContent.scrollLeft = loaderContent.scrollWidth;
    
    while (loaderContent.children.length > 5) {
        loaderContent.removeChild(loaderContent.firstChild);
    }
}

// Process queue every 200ms to create "visible" loading effect
setInterval(processLogQueue, 200);

function logToLoader(msg, type = 'info') {
    // Translate common messages to Dutch
    if (msg.includes('Fetching posters')) { msg = 'POSTERS OPHALEN...'; updateLoaderStatus("VERBINDEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Fetched')) msg = 'POSTERS GELADEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Switching to AR')) { msg = 'AR OMGEVING STARTEN...'; updateLoaderStatus("INITIALISEREN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('AR view displayed')) { msg = 'CAMERA ACTIEF'; updateLoaderStatus("SCANNEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('WebGL available')) msg = 'GRAFISCHE ENGINE GEREED';
    else if (msg.includes('Found Chunk Manifest')) msg = 'DATA MANIFEST GEVONDEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Legacy')) msg = 'LEGACY MODUS ACTIEF';
    else if (msg.includes('Starting AR.js')) msg = 'AR ENGINE STARTEN...';
    else if (msg.includes('Poster detected')) { msg = 'POSTER GEVONDEN: ' + msg.split(':')[1]; updateLoaderStatus("HERKEND"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Poster lost')) { msg = 'ZOEKEN NAAR POSTER...'; updateLoaderStatus("ZOEKEN"); }
    
    logQueue.push(msg.toUpperCase());
}

function hideLoader() {
    // Do not hide, just update status
    // The loader stays visible as requested
    logToLoader("SYSTEEM GEREED");
    setTimeout(() => {
        updateLoaderStatus("ACTIEF");
    }, 1000);
}

// Hook console.log to feed the loader
const originalLog = console.log;
console.log = function(...args) {
    originalLog.apply(console, args);
    const msg = args.join(' ');
    // Filter for relevant emojis or keywords
    if (msg.match(/🚀|📡|✅|📦|📄|🔍|📊|🎯|🎨|🧹|👁️|🔄|🧱|🎬|🛑|🚫|🙈/)) {
        const cleanMsg = msg.replace(/[\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}]/gu, '').trim();
        logToLoader(cleanMsg);
    }
};
```

}

// ==================== SYSTEM LOADER LOGIC (DUTCH) ====================
const logQueue = [];
let isProcessingQueue = false;
let queueTimeout = null;

function updateLoaderStatus(status) {
    const statusEl = document.querySelector('.loader-status span:first-child');
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = status;
}

function processLogQueue() {
    if (logQueue.length === 0) {
        // If queue is empty for a while, set status to KLAAR
        if (document.querySelector('.loader-status span:first-child')?.textContent !== 'KLAAR') {
             // Only set to KLAAR if we are not in a specific active state like SCANNEN or HERKEND
             // Actually, user wants "KLAAR" when no logs are happening.
             // But "SCANNEN" is a persistent state.
             // Let's set it to KLAAR if it was "ACTIEF" or "VERBINDEN" etc.
             // Or just simple: if no logs for 2 seconds -> KLAAR.
             // But if we are scanning, we want to see "SCANNEN".
             // User said: "wanneer er echt geen logs meer zijn de fase KLAAR staat"
             // Let's assume KLAAR replaces ACTIEF/SYSTEM READY.
        }
        isProcessingQueue = false;
        return;
    }
    
    isProcessingQueue = true;
    const msg = logQueue.shift();
    const loaderContent = document.getElementById('loader-content');
    if (!loaderContent) return;
    
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'log-line';
    line.textContent = `> ${msg}`;
    
    loaderContent.appendChild(line);
    loaderContent.scrollLeft = loaderContent.scrollWidth;
    
    while (loaderContent.children.length > 5) {
        loaderContent.removeChild(loaderContent.firstChild);
    }

    // Random delay between 100ms and 500ms for organic feel
    const randomDelay = Math.floor(Math.random() * 400) + 100;
    queueTimeout = setTimeout(processLogQueue, randomDelay);
}

function logToLoader(msg, type = 'info') {
    // Translate common messages to Dutch & Shorten
    if (msg.includes('Fetching posters')) { msg = 'POSTERS OPHALEN'; updateLoaderStatus("VERBINDEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Fetched')) msg = 'DATA GELADEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Switching to AR')) { msg = 'AR STARTEN'; updateLoaderStatus("INITIALISEREN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('AR view displayed')) { msg = 'CAMERA ACTIEF'; updateLoaderStatus("SCANNEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('WebGL available')) msg = 'GPU GEREED';
    else if (msg.includes('Found Chunk Manifest')) msg = 'MANIFEST GELADEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Legacy')) msg = 'LEGACY MODUS';
    else if (msg.includes('Starting AR.js')) msg = 'ENGINE STARTEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Poster detected')) { msg = 'GEVONDEN: ' + msg.split(':')[1].substring(0, 15) + '...'; updateLoaderStatus("HERKEND"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Poster lost')) { msg = 'ZOEKEN...'; updateLoaderStatus("ZOEKEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Video filter')) msg = 'FILTER ACTIEF';
    else if (msg.includes('WebGL cleanup')) msg = 'GEHEUGEN OPSCHONEN';
    
    // Clean up any remaining emojis just in case
    msg = msg.replace(/[\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}]/gu, '').trim();
    
    logQueue.push(msg.toUpperCase());
    
    if (!isProcessingQueue) {
        processLogQueue();
    }
}

function hideLoader() {
    logToLoader("SYSTEEM GEREED");
    setTimeout(() => {
        updateLoaderStatus("KLAAR");
    }, 2000); // Wait for queue to likely finish
}

// Hook console.log to feed the loader
const originalLog = console.log;
console.log = function(...args) {
    originalLog.apply(console, args);
    const msg = args.join(' ');
    // Filter for relevant emojis or keywords
    if (msg.match(/🚀|📡|✅|📦|📄|🔍|📊|🎯|🎨|🧹|👁️|🔄|🧱|🎬|🛑|🚫|🙈/)) {
        const cleanMsg = msg.replace(/[\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}]/gu, '').trim();
        logToLoader(cleanMsg);
    }
};
```

// ==================== SYSTEM LOADER LOGIC (DUTCH) ====================
const logQueue = [];
let isProcessingQueue = false;
let queueTimeout = null;

function updateLoaderStatus(status) {
    const statusEl = document.querySelector('.loader-status span:first-child');
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = status;
}

function processLogQueue() {
    if (logQueue.length === 0) {
        isProcessingQueue = false;
        // If queue is empty, ensure we are in a valid state
        const currentStatus = document.querySelector('.loader-status span:first-child')?.textContent;
        if (currentStatus === 'INITIALISEREN' || currentStatus === 'VERBINDEN') {
             updateLoaderStatus("SCANNEN");
        }
        return;
    }
    
    isProcessingQueue = true;
    const msg = logQueue.shift();
    const loaderContent = document.getElementById('loader-content');
    if (!loaderContent) return;
    
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'log-line';
    line.textContent = `> ${msg}`;
    
    loaderContent.appendChild(line);
    loaderContent.scrollLeft = loaderContent.scrollWidth;
    
    while (loaderContent.children.length > 5) {
        loaderContent.removeChild(loaderContent.firstChild);
    }

    // Slower, more random delay (300ms - 1200ms) for noticeable reading time
    const randomDelay = Math.floor(Math.random() * 900) + 300;
    queueTimeout = setTimeout(processLogQueue, randomDelay);
}

function logToLoader(msg, type = 'info') {
    // 1. Clean Emojis (Expanded Regex)
    // Covers: Standard Emojis, Dingbats (Checkmarks), Transport/Map symbols, etc.
    msg = msg.replace(/([\u2700-\u27BF]|[\uE000-\uF8FF]|\uD83C[\uDC00-\uDFFF]|\uD83D[\uDC00-\uDFFF]|[\u2011-\u26FF]|\uD83E[\uDD10-\uDDFF])/g, '').trim();

    // 2. Translate & Simplify (Dutch)
    if (msg.includes('Fetching posters')) { msg = 'POSTERS OPHALEN'; updateLoaderStatus("VERBINDEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Fetched')) msg = 'DATA GELADEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Switching to AR')) { msg = 'AR STARTEN'; updateLoaderStatus("INITIALISEREN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('AR view displayed')) { msg = 'CAMERA ACTIEF'; updateLoaderStatus("SCANNEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('WebGL available')) msg = 'GPU GEREED';
    else if (msg.includes('Found Chunk Manifest')) msg = 'MANIFEST GELADEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Legacy')) msg = 'LEGACY MODUS';
    else if (msg.includes('Starting AR.js')) msg = 'ENGINE STARTEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Poster detected')) { msg = 'GEVONDEN: ' + msg.split(':')[1].substring(0, 12) + '...'; updateLoaderStatus("AR ACTIEF"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Poster lost')) { msg = 'ZOEKEN...'; updateLoaderStatus("SCANNEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Video filter')) msg = 'FILTER ACTIEF';
    else if (msg.includes('WebGL cleanup')) msg = 'GEHEUGEN OPSCHONEN';
    else if (msg.includes('All GIFs already ready')) { msg = 'GIF BESTANDEN GEREED'; }
    else if (msg.includes('Pending GIF')) { msg = 'GIF LADEN...'; }
    else if (msg.includes('Waiting for GIFs')) { msg = 'WACHTEN OP DATA...'; }
    else if (msg.includes('Hiding loader')) { return; } // Skip this internal log
    else if (msg.includes('SYSTEM_READY')) { msg = 'SYSTEEM GEREED'; }

    // 3. Filter out empty or irrelevant logs
    if (msg.length < 2) return;
    
    logQueue.push(msg.toUpperCase());
    
    if (!isProcessingQueue) {
        processLogQueue();
    }
}

function hideLoader() {
    // Just log ready, status updates automatically via queue/logic
    logToLoader("SYSTEEM GEREED");
}

// Hook console.log to feed the loader
const originalLog = console.log;
console.log = function(...args) {
    originalLog.apply(console, args);
    const msg = args.join(' ');
    // Filter for relevant emojis or keywords
    if (msg.match(/🚀|📡|✅|📦|📄|🔍|📊|🎯|🎨|🧹|👁️|🔄|🧱|🎬|🛑|🚫|🙈|⏳/)) {
        logToLoader(msg);
    }
};

// ==================== SYSTEM LOADER LOGIC (DUTCH) ====================
const logQueue = [];
let isProcessingQueue = false;
let queueTimeout = null;

function updateLoaderStatus(status) {
    const statusEl = document.querySelector('.loader-status span:first-child');
    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = status;
}

function processLogQueue() {
    if (logQueue.length === 0) {
        isProcessingQueue = false;
        // If queue is empty, ensure we are in a valid state
        const currentStatus = document.querySelector('.loader-status span:first-child')?.textContent;
        if (currentStatus === 'INITIALISEREN' || currentStatus === 'VERBINDEN') {
             updateLoaderStatus("SCANNEN");
        }
        return;
    }
    
    isProcessingQueue = true;
    const msg = logQueue.shift();
    const loaderContent = document.getElementById('loader-content');
    if (!loaderContent) return;
    
    const line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'log-line';
    line.textContent = `> ${msg}`;
    
    loaderContent.appendChild(line);
    loaderContent.scrollLeft = loaderContent.scrollWidth;
    
    while (loaderContent.children.length > 5) {
        loaderContent.removeChild(loaderContent.firstChild);
    }

    // Slower, more random delay (300ms - 1200ms) for noticeable reading time
    const randomDelay = Math.floor(Math.random() * 900) + 300;
    queueTimeout = setTimeout(processLogQueue, randomDelay);
}

function logToLoader(msg, type = 'info') {
    // 1. Clean Emojis (Expanded Regex)
    // Covers: Standard Emojis, Dingbats (Checkmarks), Transport/Map symbols, etc.
    msg = msg.replace(/([\u2700-\u27BF]|[\uE000-\uF8FF]|\uD83C[\uDC00-\uDFFF]|\uD83D[\uDC00-\uDFFF]|[\u2011-\u26FF]|\uD83E[\uDD10-\uDDFF])/g, '').trim();

    // 2. Translate & Simplify (Dutch)
    if (msg.includes('Fetching posters')) { msg = 'POSTERS OPHALEN'; updateLoaderStatus("VERBINDEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Fetched')) msg = 'DATA GELADEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Switching to AR')) { msg = 'AR STARTEN'; updateLoaderStatus("INITIALISEREN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('AR view displayed')) { msg = 'CAMERA ACTIEF'; updateLoaderStatus("SCANNEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('WebGL available')) msg = 'GPU GEREED';
    else if (msg.includes('Found Chunk Manifest')) msg = 'MANIFEST GELADEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Legacy')) msg = 'LEGACY MODUS';
    else if (msg.includes('Starting AR.js')) msg = 'ENGINE STARTEN';
    else if (msg.includes('Poster detected')) { msg = 'GEVONDEN: ' + msg.split(':')[1].substring(0, 12) + '...'; updateLoaderStatus("AR ACTIEF"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Poster lost')) { msg = 'ZOEKEN...'; updateLoaderStatus("SCANNEN"); }
    else if (msg.includes('Video filter')) msg = 'FILTER ACTIEF';
    else if (msg.includes('WebGL cleanup')) msg = 'GEHEUGEN OPSCHONEN';
    else if (msg.includes('All GIFs already ready')) { msg = 'GIF BESTANDEN GEREED'; }
    else if (msg.includes('Pending GIF')) { msg = 'GIF LADEN...'; }
    else if (msg.includes('Waiting for GIFs')) { msg = 'WACHTEN OP DATA...'; }
    else if (msg.includes('Hiding loader')) { return; } // Skip this internal log
    else if (msg.includes('SYSTEM_READY')) { msg = 'SYSTEEM GEREED'; }

    // 3. Filter out empty or irrelevant logs
    if (msg.length < 2) return;
    
    logQueue.push(msg.toUpperCase());
    
    if (!isProcessingQueue) {
        processLogQueue();
    }
}
```
